sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: September 12, 1993, the Claps family were preparing for a relaxing Sunday ahead.
sentences.zh: 1993年9月12日，克拉普斯一家正准备迎接一个轻松的周日。

sentences.en: It was a sunny day in their hometown of Potenza, a mountain city in the Basilicata region of southern Italy.
sentences.zh: 那是一个阳光明媚的日子，地点在他们的家乡波坦察，一座位于意大利南部巴西利卡塔大区的山城。

sentences.en: Parents Antonio and Filomena were looking forward to spending the day off from the tobacconist they ran in the centre of town,
sentences.zh: 父母安东尼奥和菲洛梅娜很期待能从他们经营的市中心烟草店休息一天，

sentences.en: and had travelled to the family's rural property 27 kilometres south-west of Potenza, in the small village of Tito.
sentences.zh: 于是他们前往了位于波坦察西南27公里处，蒂托小村庄里的乡村房产。

sentences.en: Whilst it was only a basic and modest abode, their country house provided a haven to escape the hustle and bustle of the city,
sentences.zh: 虽然那只是一个简朴的住所，但他们的乡间别墅提供了一个逃离城市喧嚣的避风港，

sentences.en: and the family cherished the quality time they were able to spend together there.
sentences.zh: 一家人非常珍惜在那里共度的美好时光。

sentences.en: They looked forward to their Sunday lunches, filled with lively conversation and home-cooked meals.
sentences.zh: 他们很期待周日的午餐，餐桌上总是充满了欢声笑语和家常菜肴。

sentences.en: Devout Catholics, the Claps were well-liked within their local parish, and were a warm and loving family who supported each other at every turn.
sentences.zh: 作为虔诚的天主教徒，克拉普斯一家在当地教区很受欢迎，他们是一个温暖、相亲相爱，且总是互相支持的家庭。

sentences.en: This particular Sunday, Antonio and Filomena were joined in Tito by their second-born son, 20-year-old Luciano.
sentences.zh: 这个周日，安东尼奥和菲洛梅娜在蒂托与他们的次子，20岁的卢西亚诺会合。

sentences.en: The trio were preparing lunch in anticipation for the arrival of the remaining two Claps children, eldest son, 24-year-old Jildo, and the baby of the family, 16-year-old Elisa.
sentences.zh: 三人正在准备午餐，等待剩下的两个孩子到来：长子，24岁的吉尔多，以及家里最小的孩子，16岁的埃莉萨。

sentences.en: The pair were due to arrive just after midday, along with one of Elisa's friends, Eliana de Sillis.
sentences.zh: 两人本应在中午过后到达，随行的还有埃莉萨的朋友埃莉安娜·德·西利斯。

sentences.en: Back in Potenza, Elisa Claps, dressed in blue trousers, a white sweater knitted by her mother, and her trademark thin-rimmed designer glasses.
sentences.zh: 在波坦察，埃莉萨·克拉普斯穿着蓝色长裤，套着一件母亲亲手织的白色毛衣，戴着她标志性的细框设计师眼镜。

sentences.en: She kept her thick, dark hair out and flowing below her shoulders.
sentences.zh: 她留着一头浓密的深色长发，自然地垂在肩头。

sentences.en: The bubbly teenager was popular amongst her peers, who were drawn to her warm smile, sense of humour, and kind-hearted personality.
sentences.zh: 这位活泼的少女在同龄人中很受欢迎，大家都被她温暖的笑容、幽默感和善良的性格所吸引。

sentences.en: As the youngest of the Claps children, she was doted on by her family, which contributed to her caring and compassionate nature.
sentences.zh: 作为家里最小的孩子，她备受家人的宠爱，这也造就了她关怀他人、富有同情心的天性。

sentences.en: Although some noted Elisa could be a little naive at times.
sentences.zh: 不过，也有人觉得埃莉萨有时会显得有点天真。

sentences.en: Actively involved with her church, Elisa sang in the cathedral choir and studied hard towards her passion of becoming a doctor,
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨积极参与教会活动，在大教堂唱诗班唱歌，并为实现成为医生的梦想而努力学习，

sentences.en: with her dream to one day work in Africa for a not-for-profit organisation.
sentences.zh: 她的梦想是将来能去非洲为一家非营利组织工作。

sentences.en: At 11am, the doorbell rang at the Claps flat in Potenza.
sentences.zh: 上午11点，波坦察克拉普斯公寓的门铃响了。

sentences.en: It was Elisa's friend, Eliana.
sentences.zh: 来的是埃莉萨的朋友埃莉安娜。

sentences.en: The two had arranged to attend Sunday morning mass together at the Church of the Holy Trinity in the city's centre.
sentences.zh: 两人约好一起去市中心的圣三一教堂参加周日上午的弥撒。

sentences.en: They planned to return to Elisa's home afterwards, before departing to the country for lunch with the remainder of the Claps family.
sentences.zh: 她们计划结束后回到埃莉萨家，然后出发去乡下与克拉普斯一家的其他人共进午餐。

sentences.en: Elisa told her brother Jildo they would be back soon, and the two girls headed out towards the church.
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨告诉哥哥吉尔多她们很快就会回来，随后两个女孩便朝教堂走去。

sentences.en: When an hour passed and the teenagers still hadn't returned to the flat,
sentences.zh: 一小时过去了，少女们仍未回到公寓，

sentences.en: Jildo started to worry.
sentences.zh: 吉尔多开始担心起来。

sentences.en: His sister was known for her punctuality and always phoned home if she was running late.
sentences.zh: 他的妹妹一向准时，如果迟到总是会打电话回家。

sentences.en: Then, the doorbell rang, and Jildo found Eliana standing there, alone.
sentences.zh: 这时，门铃响了，吉尔多发现埃莉安娜独自站在门口。

sentences.en: The teen told him she and Elisa had become separated at the church.
sentences.zh: 这位少女告诉他，她和埃莉萨在教堂走散了。

sentences.en: Eliana assumed Elisa had returned home without her and was surprised to learn she wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 埃莉安娜以为埃莉萨已经先回家了，得知她没回来感到很惊讶。

sentences.en: Concerned, Jildo walked towards the city centre whilst keeping an eye out for his sister, before arriving to the Church of the Holy Trinity.
sentences.zh: 吉尔多心急如焚，一边四处张望寻找妹妹，一边朝市中心走去，最后抵达了圣三一教堂。

sentences.en: The surrounding area was busy with crowds of people.
sentences.zh: 教堂周边人潮拥挤。

sentences.en: But there was no sign of Elisa.
sentences.zh: 但根本没有埃莉萨的踪影。

sentences.en: As 2pm approached and Jildo and Elisa still hadn't arrived for lunch in Tito,
sentences.zh: 下午2点临近，吉尔多和埃莉萨仍未抵达蒂托吃午饭，

sentences.en: the rest of the Claps family decided to leave the food they had prepared and make the brief journey back to Potenza to see what was going on.
sentences.zh: 克拉普斯一家其余成员决定放下准备好的食物，匆忙赶回波坦察看看发生了什么事。

sentences.en: When they returned, they were shocked and distressed to learn that Elisa had gone missing.
sentences.zh: 当他们回来时，得知埃莉萨失踪的消息，感到震惊和痛苦。

sentences.en: Jildo had already recruited a bunch of his friends to scour the area, but their efforts had failed to yield any results.
sentences.zh: 吉尔多已经召集了一群朋友在附近搜寻，但他们的努力没有任何结果。

sentences.en: Jildo pressed Eliana for the exact details of Elisa's last known movements that morning.
sentences.zh: 吉尔多追问埃莉安娜关于埃莉萨那天早上最后行踪的细节。

sentences.en: Eliana eventually admitted she hadn't been completely honeSt.
sentences.zh: 埃莉安娜最终承认她并没有完全说实话。

sentences.en: The two girls had never intended to attend mass together.
sentences.zh: 两个女孩根本没打算一起去参加弥撒。

sentences.en: It had been a cover so Elisa could meet with a friend,
sentences.zh: 那只是个幌子，好让埃莉萨去见一个朋友，

sentences.en: 21-year-old dental student, Danilo Restivo.
sentences.zh: 21岁的牙科学生，达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃。

sentences.en: Elisa was reluctant about the meeting, as she knew Restivo had unreciprocated romantic feelings for her, and she found him quite odd.
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨对这次会面很抗拒，因为她知道雷斯蒂沃对她有单方面的爱慕之情，而且她觉得他很古怪。

sentences.en: But he had been persistent, as he wanted to give her a gift for passing her recent exaMs.
sentences.zh: 但他一直纠缠不休，说想送她一份礼物，庆祝她最近通过了考试。

sentences.en: Elisa agreed on account of feeling sorry for him.
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨因为同情他才答应了。

sentences.en: Although he came from a prominent family, with his father serving as director of the local branch of the National Library,
sentences.zh: 虽然他出身名门，父亲是当地国家图书馆分馆的馆长，

sentences.en: Restivo was a loner with few friends.
sentences.zh: 但雷斯蒂沃是个孤僻的人，几乎没有朋友。

sentences.en: He was often teased for his effeminate voice and mannerisms, and he lacked people skills.
sentences.zh: 他常因女性化的声音和举止被嘲笑，且缺乏社交技巧。

sentences.en: He frequently behaved strangely towards girls, bragging that he could convince women to sleep with him for the Philip Morris cigarettes he constantly had in his possession.
sentences.zh: 他对待女孩的行为经常很奇怪，吹嘘自己能用随身携带的万宝路香烟诱骗女性与他发生关系。

sentences.en: Restivo and Elisa had arranged to meet inside the church at 11.30am, just as mass was finishing.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃和埃莉萨约定上午11点30分在教堂内见面，正好是弥撒结束的时候。

sentences.en: Eliana waited outside, where she ran into another of the girls' friends, Angelica.
sentences.zh: 埃莉安娜在外面等候，在那里她遇到了她们的另一个朋友安杰莉卡。

sentences.en: Neither girl saw Elisa leave the church.
sentences.zh: 两个女孩都没有看到埃莉萨离开教堂。

sentences.en: Gildo recalled he had overheard his younger sister talking to Restivo on the phone the previous evening.
sentences.zh: 吉尔多回忆起前一天晚上无意中听到妹妹在电话里和雷斯蒂沃交谈。

sentences.en: Gildo didn't like Restivo.
sentences.zh: 吉尔多不喜欢雷斯蒂沃。

sentences.en: He found him odd and was suspicious of his interest in Elisa.
sentences.zh: 他觉得他很古怪，并对他对埃莉萨的兴趣感到怀疑。

sentences.en: The siblings had run into him during a recent holiday, and the encounter had unnerved Elisa, who suspected Restivo may have followed her there.
sentences.zh: 兄妹俩在最近的一次度假中遇到过他，那次邂逅让埃莉萨感到不安，她怀疑雷斯蒂沃可能跟踪她到了那里。

sentences.en: Despite her obvious discomfort, she had reassured her protective older brother that Restivo meant no harm.
sentences.zh: 尽管明显感到不适，她还是安慰了保护欲强的哥哥，说雷斯蒂沃没有恶意。

sentences.en: Gildo wasn't convinced, unable to shake the feeling that there was something shady about Restivo.
sentences.zh: 吉尔多并不相信，他无法摆脱雷斯蒂沃有些阴险的感觉。

sentences.en: As Restivo was the last person believed to have been with Elisa,
sentences.zh: 由于雷斯蒂沃被认为是最后一个见到埃莉萨的人，

sentences.en: Gildo called his family house, demanding answers.
sentences.zh: 吉尔多给雷斯蒂沃家打了电话，要求给个说法。

sentences.en: Restivo told him their meeting had only lasted 15 minutes, during which the pair sat by the altar and chatted.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃告诉他，他们的会面只持续了15分钟，期间两人坐在祭坛旁聊天。

sentences.en: Elisa had seemed a little troubled, as she said she had been harassed by a man in town earlier that morning.
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨看起来有点烦恼，说她那天早上在城里被一个男人骚扰过。

sentences.en: Afterwards, she left the church and Restivo stayed behind to pray, which is the last time he saw her.
sentences.zh: 之后，她离开了教堂，雷斯蒂沃留在里面祈祷，那是他最后一次见到她。

sentences.en: As the hours passed by and there was still no sign of Elisa, her brother Luciano paid a visit to Restivo's family home to question him in person.
sentences.zh: 随着时间流逝，仍不见埃莉萨的踪影，她的哥哥卢西亚诺亲自拜访了雷斯蒂沃家进行质问。

sentences.en: Restivo hesitated to answer any questions and stuttered over his answers, appearing sweaty and agitated.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃回答问题时支支吾吾，显得大汗淋漓、神情慌乱。

sentences.en: Luciano observed he had a large plaster on the back of his left hand and asked what happened.
sentences.zh: 卢西亚诺注意到他的左手背上贴着一大块创可贴，便问发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Restivo explained he had tripped over in a building site and cut his hand, requiring a visit to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃解释说他在建筑工地摔倒割伤了手，去医院处理过。

sentences.en: He insisted he knew nothing about Elisa's whereabouts or where she went after leaving the church.
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己不知道埃莉萨的下落，也不知道她离开教堂后去了哪里。

sentences.en: Luciano left the Restivo residence and returned a few hours later with Giudo in tow.
sentences.zh: 卢西亚诺离开了雷斯蒂沃家，几小时后带着吉尔多又回来了。

sentences.en: The Claps brothers were greeted at the door by Restivo's parents, who advised the siblings that their son had left for the 150km westerly journey to Naples
sentences.zh: 克拉普斯兄弟在门口被雷斯蒂沃的父母拦住，他们告知兄妹俩，他们的儿子已经出发前往150公里外的那不勒斯，

sentences.en: to undertake his dentistry exams the next day.
sentences.zh: 准备参加第二天的牙科考试。

sentences.en: Overwhelmed with concern, the Claps attended the local police station to report Elisa as missing.
sentences.zh: 克拉普斯一家忧心如焚，前往当地警察局报案称埃莉萨失踪。

sentences.en: Officers on duty recorded the details but advised the panicked family not to worry, reassuring them Elisa was a teenager and was most likely just out with friends.
sentences.zh: 值班警员记录了细节，但建议惊慌失措的家人不必担心，安慰他们说埃莉萨只是个青少年，很可能只是和朋友出去了。

sentences.en: This was frustrating for the Claps, who knew Elisa was an obedient and well-behaved girl who would never stay out without letting someone in her family know firSt.
sentences.zh: 这让克拉普斯一家感到沮丧，他们知道埃莉萨是个听话懂事的女孩，绝不会在不通知家人的情况下彻夜不归。

sentences.en: They urged the police to question Danilo Restivo but their request was dismissed, with the officers suggesting the Claps return home and wait for Elisa to show up instead.
sentences.zh: 他们敦促警方审问达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃，但请求被驳回，警员建议他们回家等埃莉萨自己回来。

sentences.en: Unsure of what else to do,
sentences.zh: 不知还能做什么，

sentences.en: Giudo returned to the Church of the Holy Trinity, this time finding the door was locked.
sentences.zh: 吉尔多回到了圣三一教堂，这次发现门锁着。

sentences.en: He tracked someone down who had access to the key and they led him inside to search the area once again.
sentences.zh: 他找到了有钥匙的人，对方带他进去再次搜查。

sentences.en: Giudo scoured the empty pews and as he approached the altar, noticed the wooden door that gave access to the upper levels of the church was locked.
sentences.zh: 吉尔多搜遍了空荡荡的座位，当他靠近祭坛时，注意到通往教堂上层的木门锁着。

sentences.en: Giudo asked to gain entry but was informed that the only person who had a key to the door was the priest,
sentences.zh: 吉尔多要求进入，但被告知唯一有钥匙的人是神父，

sentences.en: Father Domenico Sabia, known as Don Mimi.
sentences.zh: 多梅尼科·萨比亚神父，人称“米米神父”。

sentences.en: Don Mimi had left after mass that afternoon to attend the spa retreat for the next few days.
sentences.zh: 米米神父那天下午弥撒后就离开去参加为期几天的水疗度假了。

sentences.en: That night, Giudo, Luciano and their friends stayed up until the early hours, combing the streets on foot and in cars, desperately searching for any sign of Elisa.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，吉尔多、卢西亚诺和他们的朋友彻夜未眠，步行和开车搜遍了街道，绝望地寻找埃莉萨的任何踪迹。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Antonio and Filomena sat by the phone, desperately willing their daughter to contact them.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，安东尼奥和菲洛梅娜守在电话旁，绝望地祈祷女儿能联系他们。

sentences.en: The phone rang off the hook with calls from concerned friends, relatives, townspeople and journalists, but there was no word from Elisa.
sentences.zh: 电话铃声不断，打来的都是关心的朋友、亲戚、镇民和记者，但始终没有埃莉萨的消息。

sentences.en: Upon answering the phone on several occasions, the claps were simply met with a long, eerie silence.
sentences.zh: 克拉普斯一家几次接起电话，听到的却只有长久的、令人毛骨悚然的沉默。

sentences.en: The following day, Monday, September 13, police began taking Elisa's disappearance more seriously but remained convinced she would likely show up soon.
sentences.zh: 第二天，9月13日星期一，警方开始更认真地对待埃莉萨的失踪，但仍坚信她很快就会出现。

sentences.en: Elisa's family and friends took to the streets of Patenza, asking passers-by if they had seen the dark-haired, dark-eyed 16-year-old, whilst police inquired with local hospitals
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨的家人和朋友走上波坦察的街头，询问路人是否见过这位黑发黑眼的16岁少女，同时警方询问了当地医院，

sentences.en: as to whether anyone matching Elisa's description had been admitted.
sentences.zh: 是否有符合埃莉萨特征的人入院。

sentences.en: The claps printed large posters of Elisa's smiling face along with pleas for information and distributed them across the city as her disappearance began gaining media attention
sentences.zh: 克拉普斯一家印制了埃莉萨微笑的大幅海报，附上求助信息，并在全市分发，随着她的失踪开始受到媒体关注，

sentences.en: on local radio and television stations.
sentences.zh: 当地广播电台和电视台也进行了报道。

sentences.en: As the search intensified, the claps began receiving all kinds of tip-offs from members of the public, with alleged sightings coming in from all over Italy.
sentences.zh: 随着搜寻力度加大，克拉普斯一家开始收到来自公众的各种线索，声称在意大利各地都看到了她。

sentences.en: Numerous witnesses recalled seeing someone who matched Elisa's description in a white Fiat Uno vehicle, whilst anonymous callers claimed they had Elisa with them, unharmed.
sentences.zh: 许多目击者回忆说看到一个符合埃莉萨特征的人坐在一辆白色菲亚特Uno车里，还有匿名来电者声称埃莉萨在他们那里，安然无恙。

sentences.en: Police dismissed the majority of the dubious tip-offs as none aligned with the times or location
sentences.zh: 警方驳回了大部分可疑线索，因为它们的时间或地点都对不上，

sentences.en: Elisa was last seen.
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨最后一次露面的时间。

sentences.en: A plausible report from Elisa's friend D'Angelica, who had run into Eliana outside the church the previous day, claimed another of Elisa's admirers
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨的朋友丹杰莉卡提供了一条可信的报告，她前一天在教堂外遇到了埃莉安娜，称埃莉萨的另一个爱慕者

sentences.en: had been hanging around the city centre that day,
sentences.zh: 那天一直在市中心徘徊，

sentences.en: 20-year-old Ares Gagar.
sentences.zh: 20岁的阿雷斯·加加尔。

sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，埃莉萨·克拉普斯案逐渐淡出头条，尽管她的家人为保持公众关注付出了巨大努力。

sentences.en: They appeared on television and radio shows at every opportunity, and plastered posters of Elisa's smiling face around the city.
sentences.zh: 他们抓住一切机会出现在电视和广播节目中，并在全市张贴埃莉萨微笑的照片。

sentences.en: Her father, Antonio, became withdrawn whilst her brothers and mother remained vigilant, looking into every single lead to ensure no stone went unturned.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲安东尼奥变得沉默寡言，而她的兄弟和母亲则保持警惕，调查每一条线索，确保不放过任何蛛丝马迹。

sentences.en: By 1998, five years had passed since
sentences.zh: 到1998年，距离

sentences.en: Elisa's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨失踪已经过去了五年。

sentences.en: Police declared the case was still open, but the investigation was no longer active.
sentences.zh: 警方宣布案件仍未结案，但调查已不再活跃。

sentences.en: Media interest dissipated, with the case only receiving rare mentions upon approaching anniversaries, whilst the leads, anonymous tip-offs, and hoaxes had long since abated.
sentences.zh: 媒体的兴趣逐渐消退，案件仅在周年纪念日临近时偶尔被提及，而线索、匿名举报和恶作剧早已平息。

sentences.en: As the internet emerged and grew in prominence, the Claps created a website where people could find information about Elisa and the investigation.
sentences.zh: 随着互联网的兴起和普及，克拉普斯一家创建了一个网站，人们可以在上面找到关于埃莉萨和调查的信息。

sentences.en: On April 23 1999, an email was sent to the website attesting to be from Elisa herself.
sentences.zh: 1999年4月23日，网站收到了一封自称来自埃莉萨本人的电子邮件。

sentences.en: It claimed she had left Potenza at her own free will and was safe and well living in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 邮件声称她是自愿离开波坦察的，目前在巴西生活得很好。

sentences.en: She apologised for causing pain to her family and assured she had meant no harm, but had been unhappy and had to get away.
sentences.zh: 她为给家人造成的痛苦道歉，并保证自己无意伤害任何人，只是因为不快乐才不得不离开。

sentences.en: She said she had no intention of coming home and had only decided to get in contact to put her family's minds at ease, explaining it would be the first and
sentences.zh: 她说她无意回家，联系家人只是为了让他们放心，并解释说这将是她第一次也是

sentences.en: last time she would be in touch.
sentences.zh: 最后一次联系。

sentences.en: The email ended,
sentences.zh: 邮件结尾写道：

sentences.en: This is hello and goodbye.
sentences.zh: 这是问候，也是告别。

sentences.en: Forever.
sentences.zh: 永远。

sentences.en: Desperate to believe it was real,
sentences.zh: 渴望相信这是真的，

sentences.en: Philomena clung to the hopes her daughter was living happily in another continent.
sentences.zh: 菲洛梅娜紧紧抓住女儿在另一个大陆幸福生活的希望。

sentences.en: But her sons weren't convinced, knowing their younger sister had left the house with no money and no passport.
sentences.zh: 但她的儿子们并不相信，因为他们知道妹妹离家时既没带钱也没带护照。

sentences.en: They employed the services of a private investigator who traced the IP address of the email, revealing it wasn't sent from
sentences.zh: 他们聘请了一名私家侦探追踪邮件的IP地址，结果显示邮件根本不是从

sentences.en: Brazil at all, but from an internet cafe in Potenza.
sentences.zh: 巴西发出的，而是来自波坦察的一家网吧。

sentences.en: The family enquired with the cafe and obtained a list of all the registered users who had logged on to their computers that day.
sentences.zh: 家人向网吧查询，获得了一份当天登录过电脑的所有注册用户名单。

sentences.en: Logged in at the exact time the email had been sent was Danilo Restivo.
sentences.zh: 在邮件发送的同一时间，登录的人正是达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃。

sentences.en: The claps immediately informed police and demanded Restivo be questioned over the email, convinced he had crafted the lie to encourage them to give up on the search.
sentences.zh: 克拉普斯一家立即通知警方，要求就这封邮件审问雷斯蒂沃，他们确信这是他编造的谎言，目的是诱导他们放弃搜寻。

sentences.en: But they were bluntly told Elisa's case had now been shelved and there was nothing more investigators could do.
sentences.zh: 但他们被冷冷地告知，埃莉萨的案子已经归档，调查人员无能为力。

sentences.en: In an interview with journalist Tobias
sentences.zh: 在接受记者托比亚斯·

sentences.en: Jones for his book Blood on the Altar,
sentences.zh: 琼斯为其著作《祭坛上的血》采访时，

sentences.en: Elisa's mother, Philomena, later said,
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨的母亲菲洛梅娜后来这样说道：

sentences.en: Restivo is a wild beast that grew up in the foreSt.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃是一头在森林里长大的野兽。

sentences.en: If I could, I would tear out his eyes.
sentences.zh: 如果可以，我会挖出他的眼睛。

sentences.en: I could never forgive him.
sentences.zh: 我永远无法原谅他。

sentences.en: Never.
sentences.zh: 永远不能。

sentences.en: There's no saint that could forgive him.
sentences.zh: 没有哪位圣人能原谅他。

sentences.en: I can't leave Potenza.
sentences.zh: 我不能离开波坦察。

sentences.en: This is where Elisa grew up and this is where I'll die.
sentences.zh: 这是埃莉萨成长的地方，也是我将要死去的地方。

sentences.en: And when I die, I want to close my eyes serenely and say,
sentences.zh: 当我死的时候，我想平静地闭上眼睛说：

sentences.en: I did everything for Elisa.
sentences.zh: 我为埃莉萨做了一切。

sentences.en: 1,400 miles north from Potenza, across the English Channel, lies Bournemouth, a relatively quiet and peaceful seaside town located on the southern coast of
sentences.zh: 在波坦察以北1400英里处，跨过英吉利海峡，坐落着伯恩茅斯，这是一个位于英国南海岸相对安静祥和的海滨小镇。

sentences.en: Great Britain.
sentences.zh: 大不列颠。

sentences.en: With a population of approximately 190,000 residents, it is the largest town in southwest England's Dorset County.
sentences.zh: 这里约有19万居民，是英格兰西南部多塞特郡最大的城镇。

sentences.en: Given its access to the heritage-listed
sentences.zh: 由于靠近被列入世界遗产的

sentences.en: Jurassic Coast, a 155 kilometre long stretch of coastline, the area attracts around
sentences.zh: 侏罗纪海岸（全长155公里的海岸线），该地区每年吸引约

sentences.en: 7 million tourists per year.
sentences.zh: 700万游客。

sentences.en: The 1992 foundation of the new Bournemouth
sentences.zh: 1992年新成立的伯恩茅斯

sentences.en: University continues to attract students from all over the UK, Europe and the rest of the world, accounting for a vast amount of the town's population.
sentences.zh: 大学持续吸引着来自英国、欧洲及世界各地的学生，占了该镇人口的很大一部分。

sentences.en: 48-year-old Heather Barnett was born and raised in Dorset County, growing up in the small agricultural town of Sturminster
sentences.zh: 48岁的希瑟·巴内特在多塞特郡出生长大，成长于农业小镇斯特敏斯特·

sentences.en: Newton, an area known for its livestock and dairy farMs.
sentences.zh: 牛顿，该地区以畜牧业和奶牛场闻名。

sentences.en: As a young girl, down-to-earth Heather was considered shy and quiet, but she came out of her shell as she grew up, singing in the church choir and performing in local pantomimes.
sentences.zh: 小时候，脚踏实地的希瑟被认为害羞安静，但随着成长，她变得开朗起来，在教堂唱诗班唱歌，并在当地的哑剧表演中登台。

sentences.en: Friends were drawn to her feisty and joyful personality, and she was popular within the town.
sentences.zh: 朋友们被她活泼快乐的个性所吸引，她在镇上很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Her father worked as an ironmonger and
sentences.zh: 她的父亲是一名五金商，

sentences.en: Heather often helped out at his shop to earn extra cash before deciding to move to
sentences.zh: 希瑟经常在店里帮忙赚取零花钱，后来决定在成年后搬到

sentences.en: Bournemouth in her adulthood.
sentences.zh: 伯恩茅斯。

sentences.en: Over the years, the tender and caring animal lover worked as a veterinary assistant, an au pair and a waitress before undertaking a curtain-making course at a local college.
sentences.zh: 多年来，这位温柔体贴、热爱动物的女性做过兽医助理、互惠生和女服务员，之后在当地一所学院修读了窗帘制作课程。

sentences.en: Heather soon fell in love with a man named David
sentences.zh: 希瑟很快爱上了一个名叫大卫·

sentences.en: Marsh, and the two were married, giving birth to a son, Terry, in 1987, followed by a daughter,
sentences.zh: 马什的男人，两人结婚后，于1987年生下儿子特里，随后在1991年生下女儿

sentences.en: Caitlin, in 1991.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳。

sentences.en: Soon after the birth of their second child, the marriage hit rocky grounds and Heather and David sought a divorce, leaving Heather to raise her two
sentences.zh: 第二个孩子出生后不久，婚姻出现裂痕，希瑟和大卫寻求离婚，留下希瑟独自抚养两个

sentences.en: children predominantly as a single mother.
sentences.zh: 孩子，主要作为单亲母亲生活。

sentences.en: The trio moved into a ground-floor flat in a red-brick building on Capstan Road, a quiet, working-class neighbourhood situated off one of Bournemouth's main streets.
sentences.zh: 三人搬进了卡普斯坦路上一栋红砖建筑的底层公寓，这是一个位于伯恩茅斯主干道旁安静的工人阶级社区。

sentences.en: Heather supported her family by putting her seamstress skills to use, sewing a range of items for clients around Dorset County, including
sentences.zh: 希瑟通过发挥自己的裁缝技能来养家糊口，为多塞特郡各地的客户缝制各种物品，包括

sentences.en: curtains, tablecloths, cushions and clothing.
sentences.zh: 窗帘、桌布、靠垫和衣服。

sentences.en: She worked from home, enabling her time to focus on raising her two children, who were her pride and joy.
sentences.zh: 她在家里工作，这使她有时间专注于抚养两个孩子，他们是她的骄傲和快乐。

sentences.en: With limited income, Heather lived a frugal but happy life, often gushing to friends and neighbours about how proud she was of her kids and their performance at school.
sentences.zh: 由于收入有限，希瑟过着节俭但幸福的生活，经常向朋友和邻居夸耀她为孩子们在学校的表现感到多么自豪。

sentences.en: The morning of Tuesday, November 12, 2002, started like any other in Heather's household.
sentences.zh: 2002年11月12日，星期二的早晨，希瑟家和往常一样开始。

sentences.en: Forever the early bird, she arose early, tending to the family's sick cat, before preparing breakfast for 14-year-old
sentences.zh: 她一向起得很早，先是照顾家里生病的猫，然后为14岁的

sentences.en: Terry and 11-year-old Caitlin.
sentences.zh: 特里和11岁的凯特琳准备早餐。

sentences.en: The Barnett children usually walked to school, but it was a grey, drizzly day, so Heather agreed to drive them, returning home from the drop-off shortly after 8.30am.
sentences.zh: 巴内特家的孩子们通常步行上学，但那天阴雨绵绵，所以希瑟同意开车送他们，并在上午8点半后不久回到家。

sentences.en: She anticipated a normal day ahead, which typically consisted of a morning cup of tea, followed by making a few phone calls to
sentences.zh: 她期待着平凡的一天，通常包括早晨喝杯茶，给

sentences.en: clients, before sitting down to begin her sewing commissions.
sentences.zh: 客户打几个电话，然后坐下来开始她的缝纫工作。

sentences.en: Hours later, at 3.30pm, Terry and Caitlin arrived home from school, finding the front door unlocked, which they noted as odd, as their mother was known to be security conscious.
sentences.zh: 几小时后，下午3点半，特里和凯特琳放学回家，发现前门没锁，他们觉得很奇怪，因为母亲一向很有安全意识。

sentences.en: They walked inside, throwing their backpacks down and calling out,
sentences.zh: 他们走进屋里，扔下书包喊道：

sentences.en: Hi Mum.
sentences.zh: 妈妈，我回来了。

sentences.en: Heather usually met them at the door with a hug and a kiss, but strangely, she was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 希瑟通常会拥抱和亲吻他们迎接他们，但奇怪的是，她不见踪影。

sentences.en: The kids knew their mother couldn't be too far away, as her car was parked outside and the radio was playing.
sentences.zh: 孩子们知道母亲不会走远，因为她的车停在外面，收音机也开着。

sentences.en: They looked around the small flat and noticed that her sewing machine had been knocked on its side and there were some other signs of disturbance.
sentences.zh: 他们在小公寓里四处查看，发现缝纫机被撞倒在一边，还有其他一些混乱的迹象。

sentences.en: Caitlin timidly knocked on the bathroom door, calling out to ask if her mother was there.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳胆怯地敲了敲浴室的门，喊着问妈妈在不在里面。

sentences.en: When there was no response, she slowly pushed the door open.
sentences.zh: 没有回应，她慢慢推开了门。

sentences.en: Finding Heather lying on the floor, in a pool of blood.
sentences.zh: 发现希瑟躺在血泊中。

sentences.en: After seeing the terrifying scene for himself, Terry frantically called the police, telling them,
sentences.zh: 亲眼目睹了这恐怖的一幕后，特里惊慌失措地拨打了报警电话，告诉他们：

sentences.en: My mum has been murdered.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈被谋杀了。

sentences.en: This is not a joke.
sentences.zh: 这不是开玩笑。

sentences.en: The distressed siblings then raced out of the house and onto the street, waving their arms in a panic and desperately screaming for help.
sentences.zh: 惊恐万状的兄妹俩随后冲出家门跑到街上，惊慌地挥舞着手臂，绝望地尖叫着求救。

sentences.en: A couple who lived across the street were pulling up to their house when they noticed the two frantic children and quickly climbed out of their car to ask what was wrong.
sentences.zh: 一对住在街对面的夫妇正把车停在自家门口，注意到这两个惊慌失措的孩子，迅速下车询问发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Due to the sheer scale of their distress, it was difficult to understand exactly what Caitlin and Terry were saying.
sentences.zh: 由于他们极度悲痛，很难听清凯特琳和特里到底在说什么。

sentences.en: When the couple realised what was going on, they directed the siblings into their flat to wait for the police to arrive, reassuring them that they were safe.
sentences.zh: 当这对夫妇意识到发生了什么时，他们把兄妹俩带进自己的公寓等待警察到来，并安慰他们说他们很安全。

sentences.en: The police soon arrived and cordoned off the entire street, declaring it a crime scene.
sentences.zh: 警察很快赶到并封锁了整条街道，宣布这里为犯罪现场。

sentences.en: They recorded the names and contact details of all the gathering onlookers to follow up for routine questioning in due course.
sentences.zh: 他们记录了所有聚集围观者的姓名和联系方式，以便日后进行例行询问。

sentences.en: Forensic pathologists were called to the site to determine the cause of Heather's death, who
sentences.zh: 法医病理学家被叫到现场确定希瑟的死因，他们

sentences.en: soon discovered the mother of two had sustained ten forceful, fatal blows to the head with a heavy instrument thought to be a hammer, before having her throat slit.
sentences.zh: 很快发现这位两个孩子的母亲头部遭到了十次致命的重击，凶器被认为是一把锤子，随后她的喉咙被割开。

sentences.en: Her trousers were opened and her bra had been cut from the front, exposing her cheSt.
sentences.zh: 她的裤子被解开，胸罩从前面被剪开，露出胸部。

sentences.en: Her breasts had been removed with a sharp object, thought to be a 14 centimetre long knife, and carefully placed alongside her head.
sentences.zh: 她的乳房被锐器（推测为一把14厘米长的刀）切除，并被小心地放在她的头部旁边。

sentences.en: The lacerations were neat and precise, with the killer having been careful and controlled in their actions.
sentences.zh: 伤口整齐精确，凶手在作案时非常小心且冷静。

sentences.en: A lack of blood from these injuries indicated the dismemberment had been inflicted post-mortem.
sentences.zh: 这些伤口没有出血，表明肢解是在死后进行的。

sentences.en: The horrific mutilations implied the attack was sexually motivated, although no traces of semen were found.
sentences.zh: 这些可怕的残害暗示袭击具有性动机，尽管没有发现精液痕迹。

sentences.en: In both her hands, Heather was grasping several strands of human hair.
sentences.zh: 希瑟的两只手里都紧紧抓着几缕人类头发。

sentences.en: Detective Superintendent Phil James, quote,
sentences.zh: 警探菲尔·詹姆斯说：

sentences.en: For Heather's two children to come home and find their mother this way is horrific.
sentences.zh: 对于希瑟的两个孩子来说，回家发现母亲以这种方式遇害是极其可怕的。

sentences.en: Not only have they been deprived of their mother, but the killer was so callous to allow them to see her this way.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅失去了母亲，凶手还如此冷酷，让他们看到了这一幕。

sentences.en: This is the sort of thing you'd only expect to see in The Godfather.
sentences.zh: 这种事你只会以为在《教父》里才会看到。

sentences.en: The temperature of Heather's body indicated she had been killed shortly after returning from dropping her children at school, with her time of death estimated as 9.30am.
sentences.zh: 希瑟的体温表明她在送完孩子上学后不久就遇害了，死亡时间估计为上午9点30分。

sentences.en: This was further supported by telephone records, which showed four incoming calls had come through to the Barnet flat between 10.56am and 4.15pm, all of which went unanswered.
sentences.zh: 电话记录进一步证实了这一点，记录显示上午10点56分至下午4点15分之间有四通打给巴内特家的电话，均无人接听。

sentences.en: Scuff marks and overturned furniture revealed a desperate struggle in which Heather had tried to run for her life.
sentences.zh: 擦痕和翻倒的家具揭示了一场绝望的挣扎，希瑟曾试图逃命。

sentences.en: Blood spatter found on the door near an upturned stool in Heather's sewing room marked the location where she had been violently struck.
sentences.zh: 在希瑟缝纫室一张翻倒的凳子附近的门上发现的血迹，标记了她遭到暴力袭击的位置。

sentences.en: The bloodstains also indicated she had sustained the head injuries whilst close to the floor, as though she had already been knocked to the ground before being hit from behind.
sentences.zh: 血迹还表明她在靠近地板时遭受了头部重创，就好像她在被从背后袭击前就已经被打倒在地。

sentences.en: Further blood patterns showed the perpetrator had then dragged her unconscious body to the bathroom, where they inflicted the knife wounds.
sentences.zh: 进一步的血迹模式显示，凶手随后将她失去知觉的身体拖到了浴室，在那里造成了刀伤。

sentences.en: Luminol tests identified trace elements of bloody footprints made from a size 9 to 11 Nike brand men's sneaker.
sentences.zh: 鲁米诺测试发现了由9到11码耐克男士运动鞋留下的血脚印痕迹。

sentences.en: The distinctive prints started in the bathroom, then led back into the sewing room, and stopped by the time they reached the front hallway.
sentences.zh: 这些独特的脚印始于浴室，然后回到缝纫室，在到达前厅时消失了。

sentences.en: It was suspected the killer had likely swapped their blood-soaked shoes for a cleaner pair they had brought with them, before exiting the flat.
sentences.zh: 据推测，凶手很可能在离开公寓前，将沾满鲜血的鞋子换成了一双他们随身带来的干净鞋子。

sentences.en: Investigators conducted a thorough search of the crime scene and declared nothing had been stolen, ruling out the possibility the attack was motivated by theft.
sentences.zh: 调查人员对犯罪现场进行了彻底搜查，宣布没有东西被盗，排除了袭击是出于盗窃动机的可能性。

sentences.en: In addition, Heather's front door keys were sitting in the internal lock and there were no signs of forced entry, suggesting she had known her killer and willingly let them inside
sentences.zh: 此外，希瑟的前门钥匙插在内部锁孔里，没有强行闯入的迹象，这表明她认识凶手，并自愿让他们进入

sentences.en: her home.
sentences.zh: 她的家。

sentences.en: Several fibres found on Heather's body were believed to have come from gloves the killer wore, supported by the fact not a single foreign fingerprint was uncovered.
sentences.zh: 在希瑟身上发现的几根纤维被认为来自凶手戴的手套，这一点得到了现场没有发现任何外来指纹的支持。

sentences.en: Coupled with the apparent change of shoes, this evidence led police to the conclusion the murder was a carefully planned, ritualistic attack.
sentences.zh: 加上明显的换鞋行为，这些证据使警方得出结论：这是一起经过精心策划的仪式性袭击。

sentences.en: The killer had likely arrived to the scene armed with a full change of clothes, anticipating the amount of bloodshed.
sentences.zh: 凶手很可能在作案时携带了全套换洗衣物，预料到了会有大量的血迹。

sentences.en: However, they had left behind one clue.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们留下了一个线索。

sentences.en: Draped over a chair in Heather's sewing room was a green hand tower that didn't belong to her family.
sentences.zh: 在希瑟缝纫室的一张椅子上搭着一条绿色的手巾，那不属于她的家人。

sentences.en: It was stained with Heather's blood, and given its location and positioning, investigators determined it had been placed on the chair after it had received the bloodstains.
sentences.zh: 上面沾有希瑟的血迹，根据其位置和摆放方式，调查人员确定它是被沾上血迹后才放在椅子上的。

sentences.en: The killer likely brought the towel to the flat and used it to wipe Heather's blood from their face or hands, before changing their shoes and clothing and leaving the scene.
sentences.zh: 凶手很可能把毛巾带到公寓，用来擦掉脸或手上的血迹，然后换掉鞋子和衣服离开了现场。

sentences.en: The National Criminal Database was used to search for all sex offenders and people with a serious
sentences.zh: 国家犯罪数据库被用来搜索希瑟家方圆五英里内所有的性犯罪者和有严重

sentences.en: criminal record within a five-mile radius of Heather's home, but all were able to provide solid alibis for the day of her murder.
sentences.zh: 犯罪记录的人，但所有人都为谋杀当天提供了确凿的不在场证明。

sentences.en: Investigators door-knocked the area and discovered no one who was home at the time of Heather's
sentences.zh: 调查人员对该地区进行了挨家挨户的走访，发现希瑟遇害时，

sentences.en: murder had witnessed anything suspicious or heard any screams, which was unusual given her home was in a busy area surrounded by several other flats.
sentences.zh: 家中无人目击到任何可疑情况，也没有听到任何尖叫声。考虑到她家位于一个繁忙地段，周围还有好几处公寓，这很不寻常。

sentences.en: Given it appeared she had willingly let the attacker inside her home, investigators suspected the killer was likely someone close to the family and honed their
sentences.zh: 鉴于她似乎是自愿让袭击者进入家中的，调查人员怀疑凶手很可能是与这家人相熟的人，并将

sentences.en: suspicions in on Heather's ex-husband David, but could find no evidence to link him to the crime.
sentences.zh: 怀疑目标锁定在希瑟的前夫大卫身上，但未能找到任何将他与此案联系起来的证据。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the results of DNA testing conducted on the strands of hair found in Heather's hands came back.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，对希瑟手中发现的几缕头发进行的DNA检测结果出来了。

sentences.en: It was initially assumed Heather had ripped the hair from her attacker's head as she fought for her life, with investigators hopeful they may be able to identify her killer through
sentences.zh: 起初人们推测，希瑟在拼死搏斗时从袭击者头上扯下了这些头发，调查人员希望能通过

sentences.en: mitochondrial DNA.
sentences.zh: 线粒体DNA来确认凶手身份。

sentences.en: But forensic tests revealed something unexpected.
sentences.zh: 但法医检测结果却出人意料。

sentences.en: The hair had not been ripped out at all, but instead cut neatly with a sharp instrument.
sentences.zh: 这些头发根本不是被扯下来的，而是用锋利的工具整齐地剪断的。

sentences.en: Whilst the hair in Heather's left hand was revealed to be her own, the nine-centimeter-long strands
sentences.zh: 虽然希瑟左手中的头发被证实是她自己的，但她右手中那九厘米长、

sentences.en: of neatly cut hair in her right hand were identified as belonging to another woman.
sentences.zh: 被整齐剪下的头发被鉴定为属于另一名女性。

sentences.en: Further scientific testing of the hair using a process known as stable isotope analysis revealed
sentences.zh: 利用一种称为稳定同位素分析的科学方法对头发进行进一步检测后发现，

sentences.en: the unknown female lived in the United Kingdom, but had travelled to Spain or southern France and Florida less than three months before her hair had been cut.
sentences.zh: 这名身份不明的女性居住在英国，但在头发被剪掉前不到三个月，曾去过西班牙或法国南部以及佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: With such detailed analysis, police were confident this hair would help lead them to Heather's killer.
sentences.zh: 有了如此详细的分析，警方确信这些头发将有助于他们找到希瑟的凶手。

sentences.en: Detectives questioned Heather's children and discovered that about a week before the murder, a spare key to their house had gone missing.
sentences.zh: 侦探们询问了希瑟的孩子们，发现就在谋杀案发生前一周左右，他们家的一把备用钥匙不见了。

sentences.en: As she was on a tight income and couldn't afford to risk any of their possessions being stolen,
sentences.zh: 由于她收入微薄，承担不起任何财物被盗的风险，

sentences.en: Heather had the locks replaced.
sentences.zh: 希瑟更换了门锁。

sentences.en: When asked if anyone had visited their flat recently, Terry explained one of their neighbours
sentences.zh: 当被问及最近是否有访客来过公寓时，特里解释说，他们的一位邻居

sentences.en: had stopped by a few days prior to his mother's death to enquire about having some curtains made for his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 在他母亲去世前几天曾顺道拜访，询问能否为他女朋友定做一些窗帘。

sentences.en: It was the same neighbour who had consoled Terry and his sister upon the discovery of their mother's mutilated body.
sentences.zh: 正是这位邻居，在特里和妹妹发现母亲惨遭杀害的遗体后，安慰了他们。

sentences.en: An Italian man he knew as Danny.
sentences.zh: 一个他称之为丹尼的意大利男人。

sentences.en: Danilo Restivo, known to neighbours simply as Danny, had relocated to the United Kingdom in May of 2002 to live with an Italian woman named Fiamma whom he had met on the internet.
sentences.zh: 达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃，邻居们只叫他丹尼，于2002年5月搬到英国，与他在网上认识的一位名叫菲亚玛的意大利女性同住。

sentences.en: Their home was directly across the street from Heather Barnett's, overlooking her bedroom and bathroom.
sentences.zh: 他们的家就在希瑟·巴内特家对面，可以俯瞰她的卧室和浴室。

sentences.en: As Restivo didn't speak much English, he immersed himself within the Bournemouth Italian community, frequenting the restaurants and bars that gave him a sense of his home country.
sentences.zh: 由于雷斯蒂沃英语说得不好，他沉浸在伯恩茅斯的意大利人社区中，经常光顾那些让他有家乡感的餐馆和酒吧。

sentences.en: He and Fiamma mostly kept to themselves, communicating in Italian and shutting themselves off from their neighbours.
sentences.zh: 他和菲亚玛大多独来独往，用意大利语交流，与邻居们隔绝开来。

sentences.en: Restivo had recently enrolled in a computer course at a local training centre where he was also learning English to improve his chances of gaining employment in his new country.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃最近在当地一家培训中心报了一个电脑课程，在那里他也学习英语，以增加在这个新国家就业的机会。

sentences.en: Police had already questioned Restivo in the early stages of Heather Barnett's murder investigation, as he and Fiamma were the first on the scene to help her children.
sentences.zh: 警方在希瑟·巴内特谋杀案调查初期就已经询问过雷斯蒂沃，因为他和菲亚玛是第一批赶到现场帮助她孩子的人。

sentences.en: They had embraced Terry and Caitlin and taken them into their flat for support whilst they awaited for the police to arrive,
sentences.zh: 他们拥抱了特里和凯特琳，并将他们带到自己的公寓里给予支持，同时等待警察到来，

sentences.en: but didn't offer any information that could help detectives with their investigation.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有提供任何能帮助侦探调查的信息。

sentences.en: Five days after Heather's murder, detectives visited her neighbours to request DNA samples as part of a process of elimination.
sentences.zh: 希瑟遇害五天后，侦探们走访了她的邻居，要求采集DNA样本，作为排除法的一部分。

sentences.en: Restivo and Fiamma were obliged, providing fingerprints, hair samples and mouth swabs.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃和菲亚玛予以配合，提供了指纹、头发样本和口腔拭子。

sentences.en: A detective then asked to see the pair of shoes Restivo was wearing on the day of the murder.
sentences.zh: 一名侦探随后要求查看雷斯蒂沃在案发当天穿的那双鞋。

sentences.en: Although he hesitated at first, he led the detective to the bathroom where a pair of size 9 Nike sneakers were soaking in a bucket full of bleach.
sentences.zh: 尽管他起初犹豫不决，但还是把侦探带到了浴室，那里有一双9码的耐克运动鞋正泡在一桶漂白剂里。

sentences.en: Restivo explained the shoes were dirty with a bad smell and he was attempting to clean them,
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃解释说鞋子脏了，有股难闻的气味，他正试图清洗它们，

sentences.en: but the detective was immediately suspicious and confiscated the shoes for further testing.
sentences.zh: 但侦探立刻产生了怀疑，并没收了这双鞋进行进一步检测。

sentences.en: However, they didn't reveal a match to the bloody footprints in Heather's house.
sentences.zh: 然而，检测结果显示它们与希瑟家中的血脚印并不匹配。

sentences.en: Restivo was brought in for police questioning and asked about his whereabouts on the morning of November 12, the day Heather was killed.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃被带到警局接受讯问，被问及11月12日希瑟遇害当天早上的行踪。

sentences.en: He explained he had left the house between 8.10 and 8.20am to catch the bus to his computer training centre,
sentences.zh: 他解释说，他在早上8点10分到8点20分之间离开家，去赶公交车前往电脑培训中心，

sentences.en: where he had attended his classes as usual, before leaving for the day around 3.45pm.
sentences.zh: 在那里他像往常一样上课，直到下午3点45分左右离开。

sentences.en: Police looked into his alibi and discovered it checked out.
sentences.zh: 警方调查了他的不在场证明，发现属实。

sentences.en: Restivo had a bus ticket stamped at 8.44am.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃有一张盖有早上8点44分时间戳的公交车票。

sentences.en: Heather's car had been captured on CCTV footage returning home from the school run at 8.37am, meaning he couldn't have been at her house at the time of the murder.
sentences.zh: 监控录像拍到希瑟的车在早上8点37分送完孩子回家的画面，这意味着他不可能在案发时出现在她家。

sentences.en: Furthermore, records obtained at Restivo's education facility confirmed he had signed in for his computer classes at 9am, as stated in his police report.
sentences.zh: 此外，从雷斯蒂沃的教育机构获得的记录证实，正如他在警方报告中所述，他在上午9点签到参加了电脑课程。

sentences.en: With his alibi in check and no motive for Restivo to want to harm Heather, investigators returned their focus to other potential suspects, including Heather's ex-husband.
sentences.zh: 由于不在场证明成立，且没有动机伤害希瑟，调查人员将注意力转回了其他潜在嫌疑人，包括希瑟的前夫。

sentences.en: Detective Superintendent Phil James described the case as one of the most traumatic murders you can imagine, saying,
sentences.zh: 警司菲尔·詹姆斯将此案描述为你能想象到的最令人痛苦的谋杀案之一，他说：

sentences.en: By early 2003, detectives had questioned over 100 people known to Heather, but not a single one could identify anyone who may hold a grudge against the mother of two
sentences.zh: 到2003年初，侦探们已经询问了100多名希瑟认识的人，但没有一个人能指出有谁会对这位两个孩子的母亲怀恨在心，

sentences.en: or have a reason to want to harm her.
sentences.zh: 或者有理由想要伤害她。

sentences.en: With very few leads to go by, police set out to find the weapons used in the murder.
sentences.zh: 由于线索寥寥，警方开始寻找谋杀中使用的凶器。

sentences.en: They searched parks, backyards, sheds, rubbish bins and sewers around the Bournemouth area for the hammer and knife, but to no success.
sentences.zh: 他们在伯恩茅斯地区搜查了公园、后院、棚屋、垃圾桶和下水道，寻找锤子和刀，但一无所获。

sentences.en: Posters featuring Heather's photo were plastered around town, appealing for anyone with information about her killer to come forward,
sentences.zh: 印有希瑟照片的海报贴满了全城，呼吁任何有凶手信息的人挺身而出，

sentences.en: whilst a £10,000 reward was offered by Crimestoppers for anyone who had information that led to a conviction.
sentences.zh: 同时“犯罪终结者”组织悬赏1万英镑，奖励给提供能导致定罪信息的人。

sentences.en: In May 2003, police searched through Heather's computer and discovered she had sent an email to a friend the week before her murder,
sentences.zh: 2003年5月，警方搜查了希瑟的电脑，发现她在遇害前一周曾给朋友发过一封电子邮件，

sentences.en: in which she mentioned that her spare house keys were missing.
sentences.zh: 在邮件中她提到家里的备用钥匙不见了。

sentences.en: She had been unable to find them after a visit from a neighbour who inquired about her seamstress services, and she suspected he may have picked them up by mistake.
sentences.zh: 在一位邻居询问她的裁缝服务后，她就找不到钥匙了，她怀疑可能是他误拿了。

sentences.en: She left a note in their letterbox asking to have the keys returned.
sentences.zh: 她在他们的信箱里留了一张字条，要求归还钥匙。

sentences.en: That neighbour was Danilo Restivo.
sentences.zh: 那位邻居就是达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃。

sentences.en: Other than the suspicious bleach-stained sneakers, police had little reason to suspect Restivo had any involvement in Heather's murder, viewing him as an awkward and clumsy man
sentences.zh: 除了那双可疑的漂白过的运动鞋外，警方几乎没有理由怀疑雷斯蒂沃与希瑟的谋杀案有关，他们认为他是一个笨拙且尴尬的男人，

sentences.en: incapable of such a sophisticated attack.
sentences.zh: 不可能实施如此复杂的袭击。

sentences.en: Now curious as to whether they may have missed a crucial detail, they ran an online search for his name and made the startling discovery.
sentences.zh: 现在，出于好奇他们是否遗漏了关键细节，他们对他的名字进行了在线搜索，并有了惊人的发现。

sentences.en: This wasn't the first time Restivo had been a person of interest in a major police investigation.
sentences.zh: 这并不是雷斯蒂沃第一次成为重大警务调查的关注对象。

sentences.en: More than a decade earlier, he'd been a prime suspect in the 1993 disappearance of 16-year-old Italian teenager,
sentences.zh: 十多年前，他曾是1993年16岁意大利少女失踪案的主要嫌疑人，

sentences.en: Elisa Claps.
sentences.zh: 那名少女叫埃莉萨·克拉普斯。

sentences.en: Investigators revisited Restivo's alibi at the time of Heather Barnett's murder and realised it wasn't as airtight as they had initially thought.
sentences.zh: 调查人员重新审视了雷斯蒂沃在希瑟·巴内特遇害时的不在场证明，意识到它并不像他们最初认为的那样无懈可击。

sentences.en: They double-checked the sign-in book at his computer training centre, where it became evident that on the morning Heather was attacked, his sign-in time had been altered.
sentences.zh: 他们仔细核对了他在电脑培训中心的签到簿，结果显示，在希瑟遇袭的当天早上，他的签到时间被改动过。

sentences.en: Restivo had signed in at 9am, but closer inspection revealed the entry had been amended from its original time of 10.28am.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃是在上午9点签到的，但仔细检查发现，该条目是从最初的上午10点28分修改而来的。

sentences.en: Furthermore, although Restivo's bus ticket had been stamped at 8.44am, there was nothing to confirm whether he had travelled all the way to the training centre,
sentences.zh: 此外，尽管雷斯蒂沃的公交车票上有8点44分的时间戳，但没有任何证据确认他是否全程坐到了培训中心，

sentences.en: or simply disembarked at the next stop and walked the short trek back to Heather's house.
sentences.zh: 还是只是在下一站下车，步行走回了希瑟家。

sentences.en: For the second time in his life, Danilo Restivo became a prime suspect, and yet again, the evidence against him was purely circumstantial.
sentences.zh: 达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃一生中第二次成为主要嫌疑人，但针对他的证据依然纯属间接证据。

sentences.en: There was no motive, murder weapon, or forensic evidence linking him to the Heather Barnett crime scene, and therefore, not enough to warrant an arreSt.
sentences.zh: 没有动机、凶器或法医证据将他与希瑟·巴内特的犯罪现场联系起来，因此不足以签发逮捕令。

sentences.en: Police continued to appeal for information, and by the one-year anniversary of Heather's death in November 2003,
sentences.zh: 警方继续呼吁提供信息，到2003年11月希瑟去世一周年时，

sentences.en: they released additional details about her murder to the public for the first time, including the killer's Nike sneaker prints and the gruesome dismemberment of her breasts.
sentences.zh: 他们首次向公众发布了关于她谋杀案的更多细节，包括凶手的耐克运动鞋印和她乳房被残忍肢解的情况。

sentences.en: When the public appeals generated no further leads, they re-honed their focus on Danilo Restivo.
sentences.zh: 当公众呼吁没有产生进一步线索时，他们重新将焦点对准了达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃。

sentences.en: International criminal police organisation Interpol made contact with Italian authorities in Potenza.
sentences.zh: 国际刑警组织与波坦察的意大利当局取得了联系。

sentences.en: They notified them they were looking into Restivo as a person of interest in Heather Barnett's murder,
sentences.zh: 他们通知对方，他们正在调查雷斯蒂沃，将其视为希瑟·巴内特谋杀案的关注对象，

sentences.en: and requested any information in relation to his possible involvement in Elisa Clapp's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 并要求提供任何与他可能参与埃莉萨·克拉普斯失踪案有关的信息。

sentences.en: They were informed of Restivo's reported haircutting fetish and previous criminal behaviour, which only served to highlight him as a likely suspect for Heather's death.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知了雷斯蒂沃有剪头发的癖好以及之前的犯罪行为，这更加凸显了他作为希瑟死亡案嫌疑人的可能性。

sentences.en: In April 2004, police placed Restivo under surveillance, where they soon discovered the Italian had some disturbing habits.
sentences.zh: 2004年4月，警方对雷斯蒂沃进行了监视，很快发现这个意大利人有一些令人不安的习惯。

sentences.en: On several occasions, he visited Throop Mill Park, a secluded and isolated park just outside of Bournemouth that was frequented by female joggers.
sentences.zh: 他多次前往斯鲁普磨坊公园，这是一个位于伯恩茅斯郊外、僻静且孤立的公园，常有女性慢跑者出没。

sentences.en: During his visits, Restivo made efforts to appear inconspicuous, dressing in dark clothing, sunglasses and gloves, with the hood of his jacket often pulled tight around his face.
sentences.zh: 在访问期间，雷斯蒂沃努力表现得不引人注意，穿着深色衣服、戴着墨镜和手套，夹克的兜帽经常紧紧拉住遮住脸。

sentences.en: On May 11 2004, Restivo parked his car at the end of a quiet laneway near Throop Mill Park, where surveillance officers recorded him changing into a new shirt and shoes.
sentences.zh: 2004年5月11日，雷斯蒂沃将车停在斯鲁普磨坊公园附近一条安静的小巷尽头，监视人员记录下他换上了一件新衬衫和新鞋。

sentences.en: His movements were stealth, and he appeared to be attempting to go unnoticed, as he crouched behind some tall grass and observed a female jogger go paSt.
sentences.zh: 他的动作隐秘，似乎试图不被察觉，他蹲在一些高草丛后，观察着一名女性慢跑者经过。

sentences.en: The next day, May 12, Restivo returned to Throop Mill Park wearing waterproof trousers.
sentences.zh: 第二天，5月12日，雷斯蒂沃穿着防水裤回到了斯鲁普磨坊公园。

sentences.en: He continued to act suspiciously, and fears increased that he intended to launch an attack.
sentences.zh: 他继续表现得十分可疑，人们越来越担心他打算发动袭击。

sentences.en: Police decided they couldn't take the risk and approached Restivo under the guise they were enquiring about some thefts in the area.
sentences.zh: 警方决定不能冒这个险，便以询问该地区盗窃案为由接近了雷斯蒂沃。

sentences.en: He appeared sweaty and agitated as police commenced a search of his vehicle, where they discovered garbage bags, scissors, gloves, a balaclava, and a bag containing a large knife.
sentences.zh: 当警方开始搜查他的车辆时，他显得满头大汗、神情焦虑，车里发现了垃圾袋、剪刀、手套、头套和一个装有大刀的袋子。

sentences.en: Restivo explained that he found the knife at the park and had collected it to ensure it wouldn't harm
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃解释说他在公园里发现了这把刀，并将其收起来以确保它不会伤害到

sentences.en: any children, but police surveillance had captured him conducting no such action.
sentences.zh: 任何孩子，但警方的监视记录显示他并没有进行此类行为。

sentences.en: A subsequent search of his house confirmed a blade of the same description was missing from a knife block in his kitchen.
sentences.zh: 随后对他家的搜查证实，他厨房的刀架上确实少了一把同款刀具。

sentences.en: A month and a half later, on June 22, Danilo Restivo was placed under arrest in relation to
sentences.zh: 一个半月后，即6月22日，达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃因与

sentences.en: Heather Barnett's murder.
sentences.zh: 希瑟·巴内特的谋杀案有关而被捕。

sentences.en: He underwent intense police interrogation over his whereabouts on the day of her death, as well as his suspicious behaviour in Throop Mill Park.
sentences.zh: 他接受了警方关于他去世当天行踪以及在斯鲁普磨坊公园可疑行为的严厉审讯。

sentences.en: He was also pressed about Elisa Clapp's disappearance, but he remained stoic and stuck to all of his original stories.
sentences.zh: 他还被追问关于埃莉萨·克拉普斯失踪的事，但他保持沉默，坚持他所有的原始说法。

sentences.en: After three days of questioning, he was released after police failed to obtain any incriminating evidence to charge him.
sentences.zh: 经过三天的审讯，由于警方未能获得任何足以起诉他的确凿证据，他被释放了。

sentences.en: One detective remarked,
sentences.zh: 一位侦探评论道：

sentences.en: Meanwhile,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Jildor Clapp's had never given up searching for his missing younger sister.
sentences.zh: 吉尔多·克拉普斯从未放弃寻找他失踪的妹妹。

sentences.en: Two years prior had marked a decade since Elisa's disappearance, with all the local churches,
sentences.zh: 两年前是埃莉萨失踪十周年，当地所有的教堂，

sentences.en: except for the Church of the Holy Trinity, commemorating the solemn anniversary by simultaneously ringing their bells in the teenager's honour.
sentences.zh: 除了圣三一教堂外，都同时敲响钟声，以纪念这个庄严的周年纪念日，向这位少女致敬。

sentences.en: When Jildor learned that Danilo Restivo had been arrested in the UK in relation to the murder of
sentences.zh: 当吉尔多得知达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃因与希瑟·巴内特的谋杀案有关而在英国被捕时，
zh_words: 吉尔多得知达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃

sentences.en: Heather Barnett, he travelled to Bournemouth to meet with the detectives in charge of the investigation, relaying all the information he knew about their suspect.
sentences.zh: 他前往伯恩茅斯会见负责调查的侦探，转达了他所知道的关于嫌疑人的所有信息。

sentences.en: Upon his return to Potenza, Jildor plastered posters throughout the city featuring photos of
sentences.zh: 回到波坦察后，吉尔多在全城张贴了海报，上面印有

sentences.en: Heather and Elisa side by side, atop the words, We will remember them.
sentences.zh: 希瑟和埃莉萨并排的照片，上方写着：“我们将永远铭记她们”。

sentences.en: The possible connection between the two cases quickly gathered media attention, with Elisa's mother, Philomena, commenting to the press,
sentences.zh: 两起案件之间可能的联系迅速引起了媒体关注，埃莉萨的母亲菲洛梅娜对媒体评论道：

sentences.en: The person who took my little girl away from me 11 years ago also took Heather from her children.
sentences.zh: “11年前从我身边带走我小女儿的那个人，也从她的孩子们身边带走了希瑟。”

sentences.en: I wish I could see them.
sentences.zh: “我真希望我能见到他们。”

sentences.en: When I heard of her death, my first thoughts were for the children.
sentences.zh: “当我听到她去世的消息时，我首先想到的是她的孩子们。”

sentences.en: I can imagine what they are going through.
sentences.zh: “我能想象他们正在经历什么。”

sentences.en: I think I can understand how they feel having lost a loved one, just like me.
sentences.zh: “我想我能理解他们失去亲人的感受，就像我一样。”

sentences.en: I feel a bond with them.
sentences.zh: “我感到与他们有一种羁绊。”

sentences.en: Later in 2006, a plaque was erected on the street Elisa had traversed on her way to the Church of the Holy Trinity the day she went missing.
sentences.zh: 2006年晚些时候，在埃莉萨失踪当天前往圣三一教堂途中经过的街道上竖立了一块牌匾。

sentences.en: It declared,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: Along this route on September 12, 1993, Elisa Claps disappeared.
sentences.zh: “1993年9月12日，埃莉萨·克拉普斯在这条路上失踪。”

sentences.en: At a distance of 13 years, the city remembers Elisa and awaits the truth.
sentences.zh: “13年后，这座城市铭记埃莉萨，并等待真相大白。”

sentences.en: Bournemouth detectives started working closely with authorities in Italy, convinced the potential connection between Heather and Elisa's cases was too strong to ignore.
sentences.zh: 伯恩茅斯侦探开始与意大利当局密切合作，确信希瑟和埃莉萨案件之间潜在的联系不容忽视。

sentences.en: As news reports circulated throughout Dorset County, several young women came forward to report having their hair snipped off whilst travelling on public transport and in cinemas,
sentences.zh: 随着新闻报道在多塞特郡流传，几名年轻女性挺身而出，报告称她们在乘坐公共交通工具和在电影院时头发被剪掉，

sentences.en: with the incidents beginning in 2002 when Restivo first moved to the area.
sentences.zh: 这些事件始于2002年雷斯蒂沃刚搬到该地区时。

sentences.en: Furthermore, several of these women identified the Italian as the perpetrator of these acts.
sentences.zh: 此外，其中几名女性指认该意大利人就是这些行为的肇事者。

sentences.en: Whilst the majority of the stories simply involved Restivo surreptitiously chopping locks of the girl's hair,
sentences.zh: 虽然大多数故事只是涉及雷斯蒂沃偷偷剪掉女孩的一缕头发，

sentences.en: more extreme reports alleged that he was also masturbating underneath his coat whilst doing so.
sentences.zh: 但更极端的报道称，他在这样做时还在外套下自慰。

sentences.en: Women in Potenza began reporting similar incidents they had endured many years before, with 24 women in total coming forward across both countries.
sentences.zh: 波坦察的女性也开始报告她们多年前遭受的类似事件，两国共有24名女性站了出来。

sentences.en: Restivo's haircutting fetish was a major concern for Bournemouth detectives,
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃的剪发癖是伯恩茅斯侦探们关注的一个主要问题，

sentences.en: who suspected his obsession had something to do with the mysterious lock of hair that had been left in Heather Barnett's hand.
sentences.zh: 他们怀疑他的这种痴迷与留在希瑟·巴内特手中的那缕神秘头发有关。

sentences.en: Each of the women who reported having their hair cut by Restivo agreed to provide DNA samples to test against the mystery hair, but none of the results returned to match.
sentences.zh: 每一位报告头发被雷斯蒂沃剪掉的女性都同意提供DNA样本与那缕神秘头发进行比对，但结果均不匹配。

sentences.en: Bournemouth detectives consulted with the FBI, who concluded Heather Barnett's murder was not random, but carefully planned,
sentences.zh: 伯恩茅斯侦探咨询了联邦调查局，后者得出结论称，希瑟·巴内特的谋杀案并非随机，而是经过精心策划的，

sentences.en: describing her killer as a semi-reclusive but otherwise seemingly regular middle-aged man who exhibited stalker-like behaviour.
sentences.zh: 并将凶手描述为一个半隐居但外表看起来正常的、有跟踪狂行为的中年男子。

sentences.en: In November 2006, police obtained a warrant to search Restivo's flat.
sentences.zh: 2006年11月，警方获得搜查令，搜查了雷斯蒂沃的公寓。

sentences.en: Inside a chest of drawers, they discovered a lock of hair tied with a piece of cotton hidden inside a plastic bag.
sentences.zh: 在一个抽屉里，他们发现了一缕用棉线系着的头发，藏在一个塑料袋里。

sentences.en: The hair was tested for DNA, but returned no match for Restivo, Elisa Claps, or Heather Barnett.
sentences.zh: 这缕头发进行了DNA检测，但与雷斯蒂沃、埃莉萨·克拉普斯或希瑟·巴内特均不匹配。

sentences.en: As the plastic bag also contained photos of his partner Fiamma's family, it was determined the hair most likely served as an innocent memento from a family member
sentences.zh: 由于塑料袋里还装有他伴侣菲亚玛家人的照片，因此确定这缕头发很可能只是来自家庭成员的无辜纪念品，

sentences.en: and was not associated with anything criminal.
sentences.zh: 与任何犯罪行为无关。

sentences.en: Despite the unwavering efforts of police, the investigation into Heather Barnett's murder languished.
sentences.zh: 尽管警方坚持不懈，但对希瑟·巴内特谋杀案的调查还是陷入了停滞。

sentences.en: The case continued to be featured in sporadic news articles and on the BBC television show Crime Watch, which generated new leads and potential witness sightings,
sentences.zh: 该案继续零星出现在新闻报道和英国广播公司的电视节目《犯罪观察》中，这产生了新的线索和潜在的目击者，

sentences.en: but nothing substantial enough to warrant Danilo Restivo or any other individual being charged with the murder.
sentences.zh: 但没有实质性证据足以起诉达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃或任何其他人谋杀。

sentences.en: In 2006, CCTV footage was aired on Crime Watch which showed a blurry image of an unknown man crossing the street
sentences.zh: 2006年，《犯罪观察》播出了监控录像，显示一个模糊的未知男子在过马路，

sentences.en: towards Capston Road where Heather lived at 9.24am on the morning of her murder.
sentences.zh: 时间是案发当天上午9点24分，他正朝希瑟居住的卡普斯顿路走去。

sentences.en: The TV show appealed for anyone with information about the man in the footage to contact police,
sentences.zh: 电视节目呼吁任何有录像中男子信息的人联系警方，

sentences.en: prompting a shop assistant at a local pharmacy to come forward and identify the man as one of her regular customers,
sentences.zh: 促使当地一家药店的店员站出来，指认该男子是她的常客之一，

sentences.en: Danilo Restivo.
sentences.zh: 达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃。

sentences.en: However, as this witness was already aware that Restivo was a person of interest in Heather's murder, police were dubious as to whether this had influenced her identification.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于该证人已经知道雷斯蒂沃是希瑟谋杀案的关注对象，警方怀疑这是否影响了她的辨认。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in Italy, in 2007, a thread was created on Italian community website Popolo Dallarete discussing Elisa Clapp's murder.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在意大利，2007年，意大利社区网站“Popolo Dallarete”上创建了一个讨论埃莉萨·克拉普斯谋杀案的帖子。

sentences.en: Over 350,000 people engaged with the site to share theories, rumours and speculations.
sentences.zh: 超过35万人参与了该网站，分享理论、谣言和猜测。

sentences.en: Many posts defended Danilo Restivo and accused the Clapp's family of running a smear campaign to destroy his family's reputation.
sentences.zh: 许多帖子为达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃辩护，并指责克拉普斯一家发起抹黑运动，以摧毁他家族的名誉。

sentences.en: A private investigator hired by Elisa's family infiltrated the site, discovering that Restivo himself was behind several of the user's accounts.
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨家人聘请的一名私家侦探渗透进了该网站，发现雷斯蒂沃本人就是其中几个用户账号的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: Then, in 2008, advances in technology led to retesting of the mysterious green, blood-stained towel found in Heather Barnett's flat.
sentences.zh: 随后，在2008年，技术的进步促使人们对在希瑟·巴内特家中发现的那条神秘的绿色血迹毛巾进行了重新检测。

sentences.en: The blood on the towel had already been determined to belong to Heather,
sentences.zh: 毛巾上的血迹早已确定属于希瑟，

sentences.en: but it had long since been speculated that the killer had used the towel to wipe clean their own face or hands.
sentences.zh: 但长期以来人们一直推测凶手曾用这条毛巾擦拭过自己的脸或手。

sentences.en: This time, forensic experts were able to test for traces of sweat and skin flakes.
sentences.zh: 这一次，法医专家能够检测出汗液和皮屑的痕迹。

sentences.en: Whilst the results were unable to determine with 100% certainty whether the traces came from Danilo Restivo,
sentences.zh: 虽然检测结果无法百分之百确定这些痕迹是否来自达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃（Danilo Restivo），

sentences.en: experts ruled there was only a 1 in 57,000 chance that the DNA belonged to someone else.
sentences.zh: 但专家判定，DNA属于其他人的概率仅为五万七千分之一。

sentences.en: In 2009, Restivo's bleach-soaked Nike sneakers were also subject to advanced forensic testing.
sentences.zh: 2009年，雷斯蒂沃那双浸满漂白剂的耐克运动鞋也接受了先进的法医鉴定。

sentences.en: Trace elements of blood were uncovered on the inside of the shoes, indicating Restivo had blood on his socks when he placed his feet inside the trainers.
sentences.zh: 鞋内发现了微量的血迹，这表明雷斯蒂沃在穿上这双运动鞋时，他的袜子上沾有血迹。

sentences.en: This supported investigators' initial theories that Heather's killer had brought a second pair of shoes to change into following the attack.
sentences.zh: 这支持了调查人员最初的推论，即希瑟（Heather）的凶手在行凶后带了第二双鞋来更换。

sentences.en: However, the exposure to bleach had rendered it impossible to obtain a DNA profile from the blood.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于漂白剂的腐蚀，已无法从这些血迹中提取出DNA图谱。

sentences.en: Restivo's explanation as to why he was bleaching his shoes was that he thought the bleach was soap, adding he must have gotten the Italian and English words mixed up.
sentences.zh: 对于为什么要用漂白剂清洗鞋子，雷斯蒂沃解释说他以为漂白剂是肥皂，还补充说他一定是把意大利语和英语单词搞混了。

sentences.en: The evidence against Restivo was mounting, but police were determined to uncover concrete proof before proceeding with an arrest,
sentences.zh: 针对雷斯蒂沃的证据越来越多，但警方决心在逮捕前找到确凿的证据，

sentences.en: knowing a jury could easily deliver a not guilty verdict if presented with the evidence they had obtained so far.
sentences.zh: 因为他们知道，如果只凭目前掌握的证据，陪审团很容易做出无罪判决。

sentences.en: Then, on March 17, 2010, something unexpected happened.
sentences.zh: 随后，在2010年3月17日，发生了意想不到的事情。

sentences.en: In Patanza, maintenance workers were undertaking repairs on the Church of the Holy Trinity, which had been damaged by leaks throughout the winter season.
sentences.zh: 在波坦察（Potenza），维修工人们正在对圣三一教堂（Church of the Holy Trinity）进行修缮，该教堂在整个冬季因漏水而受损。

sentences.en: Two maintenance workers entered a wooden door by the altar and ventured upstairs to the building's attic which overlooked the city.
sentences.zh: 两名维修工人穿过祭坛旁的一扇木门，冒险走上楼，来到了俯瞰全城的教堂阁楼。

sentences.en: Using a torch to illuminate the dark area, one worker began searching the space for damage when he noticed something lying in the corner of the room behind a pile of rubble.
sentences.zh: 一名工人用手电筒照亮黑暗区域，开始搜寻损坏处，这时他注意到房间角落里的一堆瓦砾后躺着什么东西。

sentences.en: He shone his light on the object and realised in horror that he was looking at a mummified human body.
sentences.zh: 他用光照向那个物体，惊恐地发现自己看到的是一具木乃伊化的尸体。

sentences.en: Police and forensic investigators were called to the scene where inspection of the body and surrounding area revealed several items of well-preserved clothing and jewellery,
sentences.zh: 警方和法医调查人员被召集到现场，对尸体及周边区域的检查发现了多件保存完好的衣物和首饰，

sentences.en: including a pair of shoes, a necklace, and round-rimmed eyeglasses.
sentences.zh: 其中包括一双鞋、一条项链和一副圆框眼镜。

sentences.en: The items were shown to the Claps family, who confirmed them to be the items Elisa had worn the day she went missing.
sentences.zh: 这些物品被展示给克拉普斯（Claps）一家，他们确认这些正是埃莉萨（Elisa）失踪当天所穿戴的物品。

sentences.en: The heavily decomposed body was taken for DNA testing, confirming that after 16 years, Elisa Claps had finally been found.
sentences.zh: 这具高度腐烂的尸体被送去进行DNA检测，证实了在失踪16年后，埃莉萨·克拉普斯终于被找到了。

sentences.en: An autopsy revealed the teenager had been stabbed nine times in the chest and back before being suffocated.
sentences.zh: 尸检显示，这名少女在被窒息前，胸部和背部被刺了九刀。

sentences.en: The murder weapon was likely a pair of scissors, with defence wounds to her hands indicating Elisa had fought against her attacker.
sentences.zh: 凶器很可能是一把剪刀，她手上的防御性伤口表明埃莉萨曾与袭击者搏斗过。

sentences.en: Her pants had been cut down the front and sides, and her bra had been cut from the front.
sentences.zh: 她的裤子正面和侧面被割开，胸罩也从前面被剪断。

sentences.en: Bruising around her pelvis indicated she had been sexually assaulted, although no traces of semen were detected.
sentences.zh: 骨盆周围的淤青表明她曾遭到性侵，尽管没有检测到精液痕迹。

sentences.en: In her hands were two separate locks of neatly cut hair, and more bundles also lay alongside her body.
sentences.zh: 她的手中握着两束剪得整整齐齐的头发，尸体旁边还散落着更多发束。

sentences.en: It was concluded that Elisa had likely been killed in the attic of the church on the day of her disappearance,
sentences.zh: 结论是，埃莉萨很可能是在失踪当天就在教堂阁楼里被杀害的，

sentences.en: before her body was dragged into the corner of the room and covered with rubble.
sentences.zh: 随后尸体被拖到房间角落并用瓦砾覆盖。

sentences.en: Traces of another person's DNA were found and sent to geneticist Professor Vincenzo Pascali at the Catholic University of the Sacred Heart in Rome.
sentences.zh: 现场发现了另一个人的DNA痕迹，并被送往罗马圣心天主教大学的遗传学家文森佐·帕斯卡利（Vincenzo Pascali）教授处。

sentences.en: Professor Pascali had strong ties to the Church of the Holy Trinity, and his examination of the crucial unknown DNA at Elisa Claps' crime scene
sentences.zh: 帕斯卡利教授与圣三一教堂关系密切，他对埃莉萨·克拉普斯案发现场关键的未知DNA进行了检查，

sentences.en: involved a quick analysis using outdated methods.
sentences.zh: 其过程仅涉及使用过时方法的快速分析。

sentences.en: He promptly ruled the DNA did not come from prime suspect Danilo Restivo.
sentences.zh: 他很快断定该DNA并非来自头号嫌疑人达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃。

sentences.en: Seeking a second opinion, the magistrate in charge of the murder investigation sent the DNA to the Department of Scientific Investigations,
sentences.zh: 为了寻求第二意见，负责谋杀案调查的法官将DNA送往科学调查部门，

sentences.en: who declared the DNA was indeed a match to Danilo Restivo.
sentences.zh: 他们宣布该DNA确实与达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃相符。

sentences.en: Professor Pascali was later convicted of forgery and given an 18-month suspended sentence.
sentences.zh: 帕斯卡利教授后来因伪造罪被判刑，并被判处18个月缓刑。

sentences.en: As news spread that Elisa Claps had been discovered in the very location she was last seen, the people of Patanza flocked to lay flowers,
sentences.zh: 随着埃莉萨·克拉普斯在最后一次露面的地点被发现的消息传开，波坦察的人们纷纷涌向圣三一教堂的台阶前献花，

sentences.en: plants and teddy bears at the steps of the Church of the Holy Trinity.
sentences.zh: 摆放植物和泰迪熊。

sentences.en: Citizens reeled over the reality that for close to two decades,
sentences.zh: 市民们对这样一个现实感到震惊：近二十年来，

sentences.en: Elisa had been lying in the attic of the very place they had gathered to pray for her.
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨一直躺在他们聚集为她祈祷的那个地方的阁楼里。

sentences.en: Graffiti sprung up around town blaming the Church's former priest,
sentences.zh: 城里出现了涂鸦，指责教堂的前任牧师，

sentences.en: Father Don Mimi, for covering up the teenager's death.
sentences.zh: 多米尼神父（Father Don Mimi），掩盖了这名少女的死讯。

sentences.en: Don Mimi had passed away two years prior, taking any secrets to the grave.
sentences.zh: 多米尼神父已于两年前去世，将所有秘密带进了坟墓。

sentences.en: In a meeting with journalist Tobias Jones for his book Blood on the Altar, another of Patanza's Catholic priests, Don Marcello Cozzi, said,
sentences.zh: 在与记者托比亚斯·琼斯（Tobias Jones）为他的书《祭坛上的血》（Blood on the Altar）进行的会面中，波坦察的另一位天主教神父马尔切洛·科齐（Don Marcello Cozzi）说道：

sentences.en: The Claps family have been through great suffering.
sentences.zh: 克拉普斯一家经历了巨大的痛苦。

sentences.en: They've been violated in their emotions.
sentences.zh: 他们的情感受到了践踏。

sentences.en: To find the cadaver of her daughter in the Church has been a laceration to Philomena's heart,
sentences.zh: 在教堂里找到女儿的遗体，这对菲洛梅娜（Philomena）的心来说是一种撕裂，

sentences.en: because she's a woman of faith.
sentences.zh: 因为她是一位虔诚的信徒。

sentences.en: She went to that Church, went there to pray to the Eternal Father that she should find her daughter.
sentences.zh: 她曾去过那座教堂，去那里向永恒的圣父祈祷，希望能找到她的女儿。

sentences.en: And all that time, in that Church,
sentences.zh: 而在这所有的时光里，就在那座教堂里，

sentences.en: Elisa was up there.
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨就在上面。

sentences.en: You can imagine the storm in the heart of her mother.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象她母亲心中的风暴。

sentences.en: 12 detectives gathered outside Danilo Restivo's red brick home in Bournemouth and placed the 38-year-old under arrest for Heather Barnett's murder.
sentences.zh: 12名侦探聚集在达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃位于伯恩茅斯（Bournemouth）的红砖房外，以谋杀希瑟·巴内特（Heather Barnett）的罪名将这名38岁的男子逮捕。

sentences.en: He was handcuffed and led outside, covering his face with a towel and declaring his innocence, as he accused the police of harassment.
sentences.zh: 他被戴上手铐带出屋外，用毛巾遮住脸，声称自己无罪，并指责警方骚扰。

sentences.en: During subsequent police interrogation, he was informed that his DNA had been found on the green towel located inside Heather's home.
sentences.zh: 在随后的警方审讯中，他被告知在希瑟家中发现的绿色毛巾上找到了他的DNA。

sentences.en: He had previously denied owning the towel, but now conceded he had given it to her as a colour sample for the curtains he commissioned her to sew.
sentences.zh: 他此前曾否认拥有这条毛巾，但现在承认是他给她的，作为他委托她缝制的窗帘的颜色样本。

sentences.en: Restivo was refused bail and held in custody until the preliminary hearing scheduled later that year.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃被拒绝保释，并被拘留直到当年晚些时候预定的初步听证会。

sentences.en: Upon hearing the news of Restivo's UK arrest,
sentences.zh: 听到雷斯蒂沃在英国被捕的消息后，

sentences.en: Elisa's reclusive father, Antonio, gave his first ever interview to the Italian media, where he said with bitterness,
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨深居简出的父亲安东尼奥（Antonio）首次接受了意大利媒体的采访，他痛苦地说道：

sentences.en: One week after Restivo was taken into custody in the UK,
sentences.zh: 在雷斯蒂沃于英国被拘留一周后，

sentences.en: Italian authorities issued a warrant for his arrest for the murder of Elisa Claps.
sentences.zh: 意大利当局对他发出了逮捕令，指控他谋杀埃莉萨·克拉普斯。

sentences.en: The prosecution requested Restivo be granted temporary extradition to face questioning in Italy, but the request was denied pending completion of the UK legal process.
sentences.zh: 检方要求将雷斯蒂沃临时引渡回意大利接受审讯，但该请求在英国法律程序完成前被拒绝。

sentences.en: The preliminary hearing for Heather Barnett's case commenced on November 8, 2010, where Restivo entered his plea of not guilty.
sentences.zh: 希瑟·巴内特案的初步听证会于2010年11月8日开始，雷斯蒂沃在会上表示不认罪。

sentences.en: Members of Elisa's family were in attendance, who held under strong hopes the accused killer would receive a prison sentence in the UK instead of Italy,
sentences.zh: 埃莉萨的家人出席了听证会，他们怀着强烈的希望，认为这名被控杀人犯应该在英国而不是意大利被判刑，

sentences.en: where they feared he might be able to find a way around the system.
sentences.zh: 因为他们担心他在意大利可能会找到逃避法律制裁的方法。

sentences.en: On May 4, 2011,
Restivo faced trial in the Winchester Crown Court overseen by presiding judge Justice Ian Burnett.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃在温彻斯特刑事法庭（Winchester Crown Court）受审，由伊恩·伯内特（Justice Ian Burnett）法官主持。

sentences.en: An interpreter was present for the entire duration, translating from English to Italian, as television crews gathered from across the UK, Europe and the United States.
sentences.zh: 庭审全程有翻译在场，将英语翻译成意大利语，来自英国、欧洲和美国的电视摄制组聚集在此。

sentences.en: The prosecution had been permitted to present evidence relating to Elisa's murder,
sentences.zh: 检方获准提交与埃莉萨谋杀案相关的证据，

sentences.en: telling the jury that whilst they were not required to deliver a verdict in relation to that case, the evidence served to prove that the killings of both victims were so similar
sentences.zh: 并告诉陪审团，虽然他们不需要对该案做出裁决，但这些证据足以证明两名受害者的遇害过程极其相似，

sentences.en: that there was no doubt they were both done by the same person.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，两人都是被同一个人杀害的。

sentences.en: The evidence linking Restivo to Heather Barnett's murder was presented over the course of seven weeks, including the bleach-soaked Nike sneakers, the green towel,
sentences.zh: 将雷斯蒂沃与希瑟·巴内特谋杀案联系起来的证据在七周的时间里被一一呈现，包括浸满漂白剂的耐克运动鞋、绿色毛巾、

sentences.en: the police surveillance videos at Throop Mill Park, and the CCTV footage of the man crossing the street towards Heather's house, which one witness had identified as Restivo.
sentences.zh: 警方在斯鲁普磨坊公园（Throop Mill Park）的监控录像，以及监控拍到的那名男子穿过街道走向希瑟家的画面，一名证人已将其指认为雷斯蒂沃。

sentences.en: To highlight his haircutting fetish and the link to the hair placed in Heather's hands,
sentences.zh: 为了突出他剪头发的癖好以及与希瑟手中头发的联系，

sentences.en: various women from both Bournemouth and Potenza testified that Restivo had given them unwanted haircuts during bus rides and in cinemas.
sentences.zh: 来自伯恩茅斯和波坦察的多名女性出庭作证，称雷斯蒂沃曾在公交车上和电影院里对她们进行过未经允许的剪发。

sentences.en: The prosecution worked to discredit Restivo's alibi, pointing out the training centre's sign-in book had been doctored
sentences.zh: 检方努力推翻雷斯蒂沃的不在场证明，指出培训中心的签到簿被篡改过，

sentences.en: and arguing the accused could have easily purchased a bus ticket and disembarked straight away to fabricate that he was commuting at the time.
sentences.zh: 并辩称被告完全可以买一张车票，然后立即下车，从而制造出他当时正在通勤的假象。

sentences.en: They also presented new evidence that had come to light since Restivo's arreSt.
sentences.zh: 他们还提交了雷斯蒂沃被捕后才浮出水面的新证据。

sentences.en: Forensic computer experts had searched the hard drive of the computer he had used at the training centre on November 12, 2002, the day of Heather's murder,
sentences.zh: 法医计算机专家搜索了他于2002年11月12日（即希瑟遇害当天）在培训中心使用的电脑硬盘，

sentences.en: which revealed that no human activity was found on the computer between 9.08 and 10.10am that day.
sentences.zh: 结果显示，当天上午9点08分至10点10分之间，电脑没有任何人类活动记录。

sentences.en: Furthermore, in the weeks and months following the crime, the computer had been used to search for information and updates regarding the case,
sentences.zh: 此外，在案发后的几周和几个月里，这台电脑曾被用来搜索有关该案件的信息和最新进展，

sentences.en: including any reported witness sightings and the £10,000 reward.
sentences.zh: 包括任何报道的目击者线索和1万英镑的悬赏金。

sentences.en: Italian witnesses and law enforcement agents were called to discuss the circumstances of Elisa Clapp's disappearance and murder,
sentences.zh: 意大利证人和执法人员被传唤讨论埃莉萨·克拉普斯失踪和遇害的情况，

sentences.en: with one forensic expert concluding there were similarities in the way both victims' bras had been cut from the front.
sentences.zh: 其中一位法医专家总结称，两名受害者的胸罩被从前面剪开的方式存在相似之处。

sentences.en: Danilo Restivo took the stand, denying being the figure captured on the CCTV footage on Heather's street on the morning of her murder.
sentences.zh: 达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃出庭作证，否认自己是希瑟遇害当天早上监控录像中拍到的那个身影。

sentences.en: When presented with the surveillance team's findings that he appeared to be stalking women in Throop Mill Park,
sentences.zh: 当被问及监控小组发现他似乎在斯鲁普磨坊公园跟踪女性时，

sentences.en: Restivo explained he had only gone there to enjoy the wildlife.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃解释说他去那里只是为了欣赏野生动物。

sentences.en: He reasoned the balaclava found in his car was to help with his sinus problems, and that he had changed clothes in the park due to thyroid issues.
sentences.zh: 他辩称在他车里发现的巴拉克拉法帽（头套）是为了缓解鼻窦问题，而在公园换衣服是因为甲状腺问题。

sentences.en: To account for any discrepancies in his stories, he claimed he suffered from sleep apnea which had a negative impact on his memory.
sentences.zh: 为了解释他供词中的矛盾之处，他声称自己患有睡眠呼吸暂停症，这对他的记忆力产生了负面影响。

sentences.en: Under cross-examination, he denied masturbating in public, but admitted to the haircutting incidents, saying the habit started as a dare when he was 15 years old.
sentences.zh: 在交叉盘问中，他否认在公共场合自慰，但承认了剪头发的事件，称这种习惯始于他15岁时的一次打赌。

sentences.en: From there, he realised he liked the feel and smell of hair and continued doing it, meaning no harm and not realising it was an offence to do so.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他意识到自己喜欢头发的触感和气味，于是继续这样做，并表示自己并无恶意，也没意识到这样做是违法的。

sentences.en: In a bid to gain sympathy from the jury, he presented himself as a misunderstood and lonely man who just wanted to be loved.
sentences.zh: 为了博取陪审团的同情，他将自己塑造成一个被误解、孤独、只想被爱的男人。

sentences.en: His manipulative tactic was obvious, with one Italian reporter remarking,
sentences.zh: 他这种操纵性的策略显而易见，一位意大利记者评论道：

sentences.en: On June 30, 2011, the jury of seven men and five women deliberated for five hours before delivering their verdict.
sentences.zh: 2011年6月30日，由七名男性和五名女性组成的陪审团在审议五小时后做出了裁决。

sentences.en: After nine years of intense investigation, Danilo Restivo was found guilty for the murder of Heather Barnett.
sentences.zh: 经过九年的深入调查，达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃被判谋杀希瑟·巴内特罪名成立。

sentences.en: In sentencing, Heather's daughter Caitlin presented her victim impact statement, which read,
sentences.zh: 在量刑阶段，希瑟的女儿凯特琳（Caitlin）宣读了受害者影响陈述，内容如下：

sentences.en: I used to have nightmares and flashbacks reminding me of the events of November 12.
sentences.zh: 我曾经做噩梦，闪回11月12日发生的事件。

sentences.en: I also don't like going into bathrooMs.
sentences.zh: 我也不喜欢进浴室。

sentences.en: I used to think that someone might be waiting for me.
sentences.zh: 我过去常想，可能有人在等我。

sentences.en: Now, I just hold a fear of what's behind the bathroom door.
sentences.zh: 现在，我只是害怕浴室门后有什么。

sentences.en: It was at that moment that I felt as if my heart had been ripped out.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，我感觉自己的心仿佛被掏空了。

sentences.en: My mum is no longer able to help me celebrate my successes and to pull me through the disappointments.
sentences.zh: 我的妈妈再也不能帮我庆祝成功，也不能在我失望时拉我一把了。

sentences.en: I will never get the chance again to tell her how much I love her and how much I now miss her.
sentences.zh: 我再也没有机会告诉她我有多爱她，以及我现在有多么想念她。

sentences.en: I feel a great anger at the accused.
sentences.zh: 我对被告感到无比愤怒。

sentences.en: Without him, she'd still be here.
sentences.zh: 如果没有他，她现在还会在这里。

sentences.en: How could he intrude into our safe and happy family home and then take everything from us in such a horrific and callous way?
sentences.zh: 他怎么能闯入我们安全幸福的家，然后以如此可怕和冷酷的方式夺走我们的一切？

sentences.en: During his sentencing remarks, Justice Burnett declared,
sentences.zh: 在宣读量刑意见时，伯内特法官宣布：

sentences.en: This feature of the case will haunt those who sat through it.
sentences.zh: 此案的这一特征将困扰所有旁听过庭审的人。

sentences.en: Why you picked Heather Barnett as your victim I do not know, but it's clear that you did so to satisfy a sadistic sexual appetite.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你为什么选择希瑟·巴内特作为受害者，但很明显，你这样做是为了满足变态的性欲。

sentences.en: The evidence in this case shows you are a cold, depraved, calculated killer.
sentences.zh: 本案的证据表明，你是一个冷血、堕落、处心积虑的杀手。

sentences.en: Danilo Restivo was sentenced to life in prison with no minimum term.
sentences.zh: 达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃被判处终身监禁，且没有最低刑期。

sentences.en: Outside court, Heather's brother Ben expressed his relief at the verdict, saying,
sentences.zh: 庭审结束后，希瑟的兄弟本（Ben）表达了他对判决的宽慰，他说：

sentences.en: Our biggest fear was always that this might happen to somebody else.
sentences.zh: 我们最大的恐惧一直是这可能会发生在别人身上。

sentences.en: Restivo has already had eight years of freedom that my sister never had.
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃已经享受了八年的自由，而我姐姐却从未拥有过。

sentences.en: I've thought about the death penalty, but I think it's too good for him.
sentences.zh: 我考虑过死刑，但我认为那对他来说太便宜了。

sentences.en: It seems like the easy way out.
sentences.zh: 那似乎是一种解脱。

sentences.en: I think he's going to have a miserable rest of his life in prison.
sentences.zh: 我想他在监狱里余下的日子会过得很悲惨。

sentences.en: In Italy on July 1, 2011, almost 18 years after her murder, a white coffin containing Elisa Clapp's body was displayed at her former high school,
sentences.zh: 2011年7月1日，在意大利，距离她遇害近18年后，装有埃莉萨·克拉普斯遗体的白色棺材被陈列在她曾经就读的高中，

sentences.en: along with an image of her smiling face, as the people of Patanza gathered to pay their final respects.
sentences.zh: 旁边放着她微笑的照片，波坦察的人们聚集在一起表达最后的敬意。

sentences.en: The following day, an outdoor funeral was held in one of the town squares, as the Clapp's family refused to put Elisa back inside a church.
sentences.zh: 第二天，一场露天葬礼在镇上的一个广场举行，因为克拉普斯一家拒绝让埃莉萨再次进入教堂。

sentences.en: Over 7,000 mourners attended the memorial, including politicians, mayors and officials from nearby towns,
sentences.zh: 超过7000名哀悼者参加了追悼会，包括来自附近城镇的政客、市长和官员，

sentences.en: with many local businesses shutting down for the duration of the service to honour the teenager's memory.
sentences.zh: 许多当地企业在仪式期间停业，以纪念这位少女。

sentences.en: Father Don Marcello Cozzi, who had provided unwavering support to the Clapp's family over the years, delivered the service.
sentences.zh: 多年来一直为克拉普斯一家提供坚定支持的马尔切洛·科齐神父主持了仪式。

sentences.en: He gave an impassioned speech about the unjust nature of Elisa's death.
sentences.zh: 他发表了一场关于埃莉萨之死不公的激昂演讲。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用如下：

sentences.en: Lord,
sentences.zh: 主啊，

sentences.en: how was it possible that the life of a just blossoming flower was cut off and then left to rot in the dark corner like someone threw away a weed?
sentences.zh: 一朵刚刚绽放的花朵的生命，怎么可能就这样被掐断，然后像丢弃杂草一样被遗弃在黑暗的角落里腐烂？

sentences.en: And how was it possible that all that happened in a church?
sentences.zh: 这一切怎么可能发生在教堂里？

sentences.en: Your church, Lord.
sentences.zh: 你的教堂，主啊。

sentences.en: We would like to talk to you, with so much suffering in our hearts, about those who preferred to whisper rather than shout.
sentences.zh: 我们怀着无比沉痛的心情，想和你谈谈那些宁愿低声细语也不愿大声疾呼的人。
