sentences.en: Following the service, Elisa's lily-covered coffin was finally laid to rest at the Patanza Cemetery, her gravestone declaring,
sentences.zh: 仪式结束后，覆盖着百合花的埃莉萨的棺材最终被安葬在波坦察公墓，她的墓碑上写着：

sentences.en: My long journey in the dark has finished on a warm spring day.
sentences.zh: 我在黑暗中的漫长旅程终于在一个温暖的春日结束了。

sentences.en: I am finally home.
sentences.zh: 我终于回家了。

sentences.en: On November 8, 2011, a laser-collapse murder trial was held in Salerno, a port city southeast of Naples.
sentences.zh: 2011年11月8日，在那不勒斯东南部的港口城市萨莱诺（Salerno）举行了一场谋杀案审判。

sentences.en: Italian authorities had issued a warrant for Restivo's extradition from the United Kingdom.
sentences.zh: 意大利当局已对雷斯蒂沃发出了从英国引渡的逮捕令。

sentences.en: But as the convicted killer had appealed his conviction for Heather Barnett's murder, the extradition warrant was rejected and the Italian trial proceeded in absentia.
sentences.zh: 但由于这名被定罪的杀手已就希瑟·巴内特谋杀案的判决提出上诉，引渡令被拒绝，意大利的审判在缺席的情况下进行。

sentences.en: Restivo accepted the prosecution's case and chose not to enter a plea, requesting a shortened right trial,
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃接受了检方的指控，选择不进行抗辩，并申请了简易审判，

sentences.en: which enabled speedy legal proceedings without any dispute against the evidence.
sentences.zh: 这使得法律程序得以在不对证据提出异议的情况下迅速进行。

sentences.en: Although the physical and circumstantial evidence against him was overwhelming, the case against him was strengthened when another woman testified that prior to Elisa's death,
sentences.zh: 尽管针对他的物证和间接证据确凿无疑，但当另一名女性出庭作证称在埃莉萨遇害前，

sentences.en: Restivo had also invited her to the Church of the Holy Trinity under the guise of wanting to give her a present,
sentences.zh: 雷斯蒂沃也曾以想送她礼物为借口，邀请她去圣三一教堂时，针对他的案件得到了进一步加强，

sentences.en: just like he had done with Elisa.
sentences.zh: 就像他对埃莉萨所做的那样。

sentences.en: When he invited the woman up to the attic, she felt uneasy and left.
sentences.zh: 当他邀请那名女子去阁楼时，她感到不安并离开了。

sentences.en: To the prosecutors, this helped paint a picture of the fate Elisa had likely endured back in 1993.
sentences.zh: 对检察官来说，这有助于描绘出埃莉萨在1993年可能遭遇的命运。

sentences.en: On November 11, 2011,
Danilo Restivo was sentenced to 30 years in prison for Elisa Clapp's murder.
sentences.zh: 达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃因谋杀埃莉萨·克拉普斯被判处30年监禁。

sentences.en: Upon hearing the verdict, her family burst into tears.
sentences.zh: 听到判决后，她的家人泪流满面。

sentences.en: The Diocese of Potenza applied to sue Danilo Restivo, claiming the murder and investigation had damaged the image of the Church.
sentences.zh: 波坦察教区申请起诉达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃，声称谋杀案和调查损害了教会的形象。

sentences.en: However, a judge rejected the application on the grounds that the Church of the Holy Trinity had failed to act responsibly.
sentences.zh: 然而，法官驳回了该申请，理由是圣三一教堂未能尽到负责任的义务。

sentences.en: Since Elisa's body had been discovered, the Church had come under heavy scrutiny after it was revealed that in January 2010,
sentences.zh: 自埃莉萨的尸体被发现以来，教会一直受到严厉审查，因为有消息披露，早在2010年1月，

sentences.en: two months before Elisa's remains were officially discovered, two cleaners had come across the body in the attic.
sentences.zh: 即埃莉萨的遗骸被正式发现的两个月前，两名清洁工就在阁楼里发现了尸体。

sentences.en: They notified the new priest in charge of the Church, who had in turn alerted the Bishop.
sentences.zh: 他们通知了负责教堂的新任牧师，牧师随后又通知了主教。

sentences.en: However, the grim discovery had not been reported to the police.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一可怕的发现并没有上报给警方。

sentences.en: When this revelation surfaced, the Church officials claimed ignorance, saying they had misunderstood the information,
sentences.zh: 当这一真相浮出水面时，教会官员声称不知情，称他们误解了信息。

sentences.en: whilst it was believed the cleaners didn't come forward to authorities out of fear.
sentences.zh: 而人们认为清洁工是因为恐惧才没有向当局举报。

sentences.en: In another blow to the Church, a saw had been used to create a hole in the beams above the area where Elisa's body lay,
sentences.zh: 教会遭受的又一打击是，有人用锯子在埃莉萨遗体上方区域的横梁上锯开了一个洞，

sentences.en: indicating someone within the Church had been aware of the murder and fashioned a means for the smell of her decomposing body to escape.
sentences.zh: 这表明教会内部有人知晓这起谋杀案，并设法让尸体腐烂产生的气味散发出去。

sentences.en: A search of the attic had also revealed a mattress stained with the semen of two unknown men.
sentences.zh: 对阁楼的搜查还发现了一张沾有两名身份不明男子精液的床垫。

sentences.en: Whilst this was deemed unrelated to Elisa's murder, it indicated the Church had been used for intimate acts, with rumours that former priest, Father Don Mimi,
sentences.zh: 虽然这被认为与埃莉萨的谋杀案无关，但它表明教会曾被用于亲密行为，有传言称前神父唐·米米（Don Mimi）

sentences.en: engaged in sexual activity with men up there.
sentences.zh: 曾在那里与男性发生性关系。

sentences.en: Following the exposure of the Church's dark side, the Claps family released a statement to the Italian media which read,
sentences.zh: 在教会的阴暗面被曝光后，克拉普斯（Claps）一家向意大利媒体发表了一份声明，内容如下：

sentences.en: Once again, silence and the tutelage of interests that have nothing to do with Christian values prevail over the piety that one should have for a lacerated corpse.
sentences.zh: 沉默以及与基督教价值观毫无关系的利益维护，再次凌驾于对一具残破尸体应有的虔诚之上。

sentences.en: We believe that this havoc definitely puts an entire community on its knees.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，这场浩劫彻底摧毁了整个社区。

sentences.en: In March 2012, Restivo's application to appeal his conviction for Heather Barnett's murder was rejected, but he was granted permission to appeal his life sentence.
sentences.zh: 2012年3月，雷斯蒂沃（Restivo）对希瑟·巴内特（Heather Barnett）谋杀案定罪的上诉申请被驳回，但他获准对终身监禁的判决提出上诉。

sentences.en: His lawyers argued that it was unfair to his client that the prosecution had been allowed to use evidence from Elisa's murder at Heather's trial,
sentences.zh: 他的律师辩称，检方在希瑟案的审判中获准使用埃莉萨谋杀案的证据，这对他的当事人是不公平的，

sentences.en: and that in turn, he should at least be given the opportunity to have his sentence changed to include a minimum term.
sentences.zh: 因此，他至少应该有机会将刑期改为包含最低刑期。

sentences.en: On November 21, 2012, the Court of Appeal overturned Restivo's life sentence, sentencing him to a minimum of 40 years' imprisonment instead.
sentences.zh: 2012年11月21日，上诉法院推翻了雷斯蒂沃的终身监禁判决，改判他至少入狱40年。

sentences.en: Outside court, Heather's brother Ben expressed his disappointment at the decision, saying,
sentences.zh: 庭审结束后，希瑟的哥哥本（Ben）对这一决定表示失望，他说：

sentences.en: I feel the original sentence was a just and right one.
sentences.zh: 我觉得最初的判决是公正且正确的。

sentences.en: Whilst 40 years is long, it does not preclude Restivo killing again on release.
sentences.zh: 虽然40年很长，但这并不能排除雷斯蒂沃获释后再次杀人的可能。

sentences.en: Perhaps a whole life sentence would have given Restivo the opportunity to reflect upon what he has done, but somehow, I doubt that this would have ever been the case.
sentences.zh: 也许终身监禁会让雷斯蒂沃有机会反思自己的所作所为，但我怀疑这是否真的会有用。

sentences.en: With Danilo Restivo now convicted for the murders of Elisa Claps and Heather Barnett, investigators speculated whether he could be linked to other unsolved crimes.
sentences.zh: 随着达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃（Danilo Restivo）因埃莉萨·克拉普斯和希瑟·巴内特的谋杀案被定罪，调查人员开始推测他是否还与其他未破案件有关。

sentences.en: There were several other murders throughout Europe over the years in which female victims had their breasts mutilated, and it was theorised Restivo may have been responsible,
sentences.zh: 多年来，欧洲各地发生了几起女性受害者乳房被残忍割除的谋杀案，有人推测雷斯蒂沃可能就是凶手，

sentences.en: but no clear links were established.
sentences.zh: 但并未建立起明确的联系。

sentences.en: There was also the disappearance of 27-year-old Korean woman Erika Ranzerman, who had vanished from her home in the northwestern Italian mountain region of Alpstar,
sentences.zh: 此外还有27岁的韩国女子埃里卡·兰泽曼（Erika Ranzerman）的失踪案，她于2003年4月20日

sentences.en: on April 20, 2003.
sentences.zh: 从她位于意大利西北部阿尔普斯塔（Alpstar）山区家中的失踪。

sentences.en: Erika was never found, and following Restivo's arrest in Bournemouth, police conducted a search of his computer and found that he had saved an image of the missing woman.
sentences.zh: 埃里卡一直下落不明。在雷斯蒂沃于伯恩茅斯被捕后，警方搜查了他的电脑，发现他保存了一张这位失踪女子的照片。

sentences.en: Most compelling was his potential link to the death of 27-year-old Yong-Ok Shin, better known as Oki, a South Korean student who was studying English in Bournemouth.
sentences.zh: 最引人注目的是他与27岁的申永玉（Yong-Ok Shin，更广为人知的名字是Oki）死亡案的潜在联系，她是一名在伯恩茅斯学习英语的韩国留学生。

sentences.en: At 3am on July 12, 2002, just four months prior to Heather Barnett's murder,
sentences.zh: 2002年7月12日凌晨3点，就在希瑟·巴内特遇害前四个月，

sentences.en: Oki was walking home on a residential street after a night out with friends.
sentences.zh: Oki在与朋友外出后走在一条住宅区的街道上回家。

sentences.en: She was just three blocks from Danilo Restivo's home when she was stabbed three times in the back.
sentences.zh: 当时她距离达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃的家仅三个街区，背部被连刺三刀。

sentences.en: When paramedics arrived, Oki was still alive and was able to describe her attacker as a man wearing a mask.
sentences.zh: 医护人员赶到时，Oki还活着，并描述袭击者是一名戴着面具的男子。

sentences.en: She was taken to Pool General Hospital, where she succumbed to her injuries shortly after.
sentences.zh: 她被送往普尔综合医院（Pool General Hospital），不久后因伤势过重不治身亡。

sentences.en: There was no forensic evidence found at the scene, but residents reported hearing Oki's screams, followed by the sound of a car making a hasty U-turn and fleeing the area.
sentences.zh: 现场没有发现任何法医证据，但居民报告说听到了Oki的尖叫声，随后是一辆汽车匆忙掉头逃离现场的声音。

sentences.en: Six weeks after Oki's murder, an informant named Beverly Brown told police that 27-year-old heroin addict Omar Benguit was responsible for the crime.
sentences.zh: 在Oki遇害六周后，一名叫贝弗利·布朗（Beverly Brown）的线人告诉警方，27岁的海洛因成瘾者奥马尔·本吉特（Omar Benguit）是这起罪行的凶手。

sentences.en: Beverly claimed she was driving Benguit and two other men when he asked her to pull over.
sentences.zh: 贝弗利声称，当时她正载着本吉特和另外两名男子，本吉特要求她停车。

sentences.en: He proceeded to jump out of the vehicle and attack Oki after she refused his offer to join them.
sentences.zh: 在Oki拒绝了他的搭讪后，他跳下车对Oki进行了袭击。

sentences.en: Benguit was arrested and tried in court twice, but two mistrials were declared after the jury was unable to reach a verdict.
sentences.zh: 本吉特被捕并两次受审，但由于陪审团无法达成一致，两次审判均宣告无效。

sentences.en: The problem was that Beverly Brown was seen as an unreliable witness.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，贝弗利·布朗被视为一名不可靠的证人。

sentences.en: She had made false accusations in the past, her stories were full of inconsistencies, and some jurors noted she appeared intoxicated when taking the stand in court.
sentences.zh: 她过去曾做出过虚假指控，她的陈述充满了矛盾，一些陪审员注意到她在出庭作证时似乎处于醉酒状态。

sentences.en: In addition, CCTV footage obtained from the area of Oki's murder failed to place Beverly's car at the scene.
sentences.zh: 此外，从Oki遇害区域获取的监控录像未能证明贝弗利的汽车出现在现场。

sentences.en: But following a third trial in January 2005,
sentences.zh: 但在2005年1月第三次审判后，

sentences.en: Omar Benguit was eventually convicted of Oki's murder.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔·本吉特最终被判谋杀Oki罪名成立。

sentences.en: Despite having two subsequent appeals rejected, many continue to believe Benguit is innocent of Oki's murder, with Danilo Restivo being the real culprit.
sentences.zh: 尽管随后两次上诉均被驳回，但许多人仍认为本吉特是无辜的，真正的凶手是达尼洛·雷斯蒂沃。

sentences.en: Like his other victims, Oki was small, dark-haired, and attacked from behind on the twelfth day of the month, which some have theorised may hold some significance to Restivo.
sentences.zh: 和其他受害者一样，Oki身材娇小、留着深色头发，且都是在每月的第12天从背后遭到袭击，有人推测这对雷斯蒂沃可能具有某种特殊意义。

sentences.en: It was also the twelfth day of the month that surveillance police blew their cover in Throop Mill Park as they were concerned he was about to launch another attack.
sentences.zh: 监控警察在特鲁普磨坊公园（Throop Mill Park）暴露身份的那天，也正好是每月的第12天，当时他们担心他即将发动另一次袭击。

sentences.en: Although the murder weapon used to kill Oki was never recovered, forensic evidence has suggested the blade used was consistent with the knife police confiscated from Restivo
sentences.zh: 虽然杀害Oki的凶器从未找到，但法医证据表明，所使用的刀刃与警方从雷斯蒂沃那里没收的刀具相符，

sentences.en: following his suspicious behaviour in Throop Mill Park.
sentences.zh: 那是在他于特鲁普磨坊公园表现出可疑行为之后。

sentences.en: Police also confiscated gloves and a balaclava from Restivo that day.
sentences.zh: 警方当天还从雷斯蒂沃那里没收了手套和巴拉克拉法帽（头套）。

sentences.en: In addition, unknown strands of hair were found on the pavement near Oki's body, but these may have come from a nearby hair salon.
sentences.zh: 此外，在Oki遗体附近的人行道上发现了不明发丝，但这可能来自附近的一家美发沙龙。

sentences.en: Although elements of Oki's murder did not coincide with Restivo's known MO, her attack was conducted at the opening of a narrow, secluded passageway,
sentences.zh: 虽然Oki谋杀案的某些要素与雷斯蒂沃已知的作案手法不符，但袭击发生在一个狭窄、僻静通道的入口处，

sentences.en: with theories circulating that Restivo may have intended to drag her there for a prolonged attack that was more fitting with his MO,
sentences.zh: 有理论认为，雷斯蒂沃可能打算将她拖入其中进行更长时间的袭击，这更符合他的作案手法，

sentences.en: but he was scared off when Oki started to scream.
sentences.zh: 但当Oki开始尖叫时，他被吓跑了。

sentences.en: Omar Benguit is currently serving the seventeenth year of his prison sentence for Oki's murder and continues to protest his innocence.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔·本吉特目前因谋杀Oki正在服刑的第17个年头，并坚称自己是无辜的。

sentences.en: Heather Barnett's family have made it clear they do not intend to let the evil actions of Danilo
sentences.zh: 希瑟·巴内特的家人明确表示，他们绝不会让达尼洛的邪恶行径

sentences.en: Restivo tarnish their cherished memories of their loving sister and mother, with her two children determined to live a life that would make her proud.
sentences.zh: 玷污他们对这位慈爱的姐妹和母亲的珍贵记忆，她的两个孩子决心过上让她引以为傲的生活。

sentences.en: During Restivo's sentencing, a statement prepared by Heather's daughter Caitlin was read aloud, declaring,
sentences.zh: 在雷斯蒂沃的量刑听证会上，希瑟的女儿凯特琳（Caitlin）准备的一份声明被大声宣读，声明中写道：

sentences.en: Following Restivo's conviction, Heather's sister Denise delivered an emotion.
sentences.zh: 在雷斯蒂沃被定罪后，希瑟的妹妹丹妮丝（Denise）发表了一番感人的话。

sentences.en: We had all looked forward to life getting a bit easier for Heather as the children entered their teens and left her more time for visits and activities away from home.
sentences.zh: 我们都曾期待随着孩子们进入青春期，希瑟的生活能变得轻松一些，让她有更多时间进行探访和参加家庭以外的活动。

sentences.en: The major sadness for her family is that, through her early death, she missed the joy of watching Caitlin perform on stage, do well in her exams, and develop her career.
sentences.zh: 她家人最大的悲痛在于，由于她过早离世，她错过了看着凯特琳登台表演、考试取得优异成绩以及发展事业的快乐。

sentences.en: As Terry was a little older, she had been able to take pride in his mountain bike racing
sentences.zh: 由于特里（Terry）年纪稍大，她曾为他的山地自行车比赛感到自豪，

sentences.en: and interest in the technical side of bikes, but missed out on his career and interest in business.
sentences.zh: 并关注他在自行车技术方面的兴趣，但却错过了他职业生涯的发展和在商业上的兴趣。

sentences.en: She would have been thrilled at the recent arrival of her nephew and of her niece's son and would have been busy knitting for them.
sentences.zh: 如果她还在世，一定会为最近出生的侄子和侄女的儿子感到欣喜若狂，并会忙着为他们织毛衣。

sentences.en: Heather loved her children very much.
sentences.zh: 希瑟非常爱她的孩子们。

sentences.en: She was kind and honest with strong ethical principles, which she passed on to Terry and Caitlin.
sentences.zh: 她善良、诚实，有着坚定的道德准则，并将这些传给了特里和凯特琳。

sentences.en: She always worked hard at whatever she did and built up a business on word of mouth and reputation.
sentences.zh: 无论做什么，她总是努力工作，并凭借口碑和信誉建立了自己的事业。

sentences.en: Heather was feisty, had a deep laugh, and a wicked sense of humour.
sentences.zh: 希瑟性格泼辣，笑声爽朗，有着一种顽皮的幽默感。

sentences.en: The years since November 2002 have been difficult, but it has also been a time that has brought out the best in countless people, strangers and friends alike.
sentences.zh: 自2002年11月以来的岁月非常艰难，但这段时间也激发了无数人——无论是陌生人还是朋友——身上最美好的一面。

sentences.en: We see ourselves as survivors, not victiMs.
sentences.zh: 我们视自己为幸存者，而非受害者。

sentences.en: The Church of the Holy Trinity in Potenza is now permanently closed.
sentences.zh: 位于波坦察（Potenza）的圣三一教堂（Church of the Holy Trinity）现已永久关闭。

sentences.en: Prior to the discovery of Elisa's body and Restivo's conviction for her murder, journalist Tobias Jones asked Elisa's brother, Jildo, how he managed to keep going.
sentences.zh: 在发现埃莉萨的遗体和雷斯蒂沃因谋杀她被定罪之前，记者托拜厄斯·琼斯（Tobias Jones）曾问埃莉萨的哥哥吉尔多（Jildo），他是如何坚持下去的。

sentences.en: Jildo replied,
sentences.zh: 吉尔多回答说：

sentences.en: I made a promise to my sister many, many years ago.
sentences.zh: 很多很多年前，我向我的妹妹许下了一个承诺。

sentences.en: I promised I would bring her killer to court.
sentences.zh: 我承诺过，我会把杀害她的凶手送上法庭。

sentences.en: When you've lived with this for so long, it becomes a part of you.
sentences.zh: 当你带着这种痛苦生活了这么久，它就成了你的一部分。

sentences.en: I have a lot of fear about what will happen, one day, if it's all over.
sentences.zh: 我很担心如果这一切终结的那一天真的到来，会发生什么。

sentences.en: Having hunted and battled all those years, it will leave an emptiness when it's all over.
sentences.zh: 在经历了这么多年的追寻和抗争后，当一切结束时，会留下一种空虚感。

sentences.en: Until you have certainty, until you find a body, there's no mourning.
sentences.zh: 在得到确切结果之前，在找到遗体之前，是无法哀悼的。

sentences.en: You can't work through your bereavement.
sentences.zh: 你无法排解你的丧亲之痛。

sentences.en: You can never metabolise your pain.
sentences.zh: 你永远无法消化你的痛苦。

sentences.en: It's a suspension of life.
sentences.zh: 这是一种生活的停滞。

sentences.en: Following Restivo's guilty verdict years later, Jildo told the journalist,
sentences.zh: 多年后，在雷斯蒂沃被判有罪后，吉尔多告诉记者：

sentences.en: I don't think, after everything we've been through, that we'll never be at peace.
sentences.zh: 我不认为在经历了这一切之后，我们就能获得内心的平静。

sentences.en: But she can be.
sentences.zh: 但她可以。

sentences.en: She can finally rest in peace.
sentences.zh: 她终于可以安息了。
